  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_CApp a h => a_CApp (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_co_co c g h)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a bs => a_Case (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_brs_co c g bs)
  end
with subst_con_co (c:atom) (g:co) (p:constraint) {struct p} : constraint :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A)
  end
with subst_co_co (c:atom) (g:co) (h:co) {struct h} : co :=
  match h with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
  | g_Var_f d => if KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c then g else g_Var_f d
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (subst_tm_co c g a)
  | g_Refl2 a b h' => g_Refl2 (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Sym h' => g_Sym (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => g_AppCong (subst_co_co c g g1) rho (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_PiFst h' => g_PiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_CPiFst h' => g_CPiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_IsoSnd h' => g_IsoSnd (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3) (subst_co_co c g g4)
  | g_CAppCong h' g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_CPiSnd h' g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => g_Cast (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h' => g_IsoConv (subst_con_co c g phi1) (subst_con_co c g phi2) (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (subst_tm_co c g a)
  | g_Left h' h'' => g_Left (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
  | g_Right h' h'' => g_Right (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
  end.

Definition subst_sort_co (c:atom) (g:co) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with
  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_co c g A)
  | Co p => Co (subst_con_co c g p)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx_co (c:atom) (g:co) (G:context) : context :=
  map (fun b => (fst b, subst_sort_co c g (snd b))) G.

Lemma subst_tm_var_eq : forall x v, subst_tm x v (a_Var_f x) = v.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec x x) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_var_neq : forall x y v, y <> x -> subst_tm x v (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [E|E]; [congruence|reflexivity].
Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_star : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Star = a_Star.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_var_b : forall x v n, subst_tm x v (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_pi : forall x v rho A B,
  subst_tm x v (a_Pi rho A B) = a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_abs : forall x v rho A b,
  subst_tm x v (a_Abs rho A b) = a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_uabs : forall x v rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_UAbs rho b) = a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_app : forall x v a rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_App a rho b) = a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_conv : forall x v a g,

Lemma subst_tm_cpi : forall x v phi B,

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_fam : forall x v F, subst_tm x v (a_Fam F) = a_Fam F.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* ---------- substitution of a term for a free term-variable ---------- *)

Definition subst_tm (x:atom) (v t:tm) : tm :=
  open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm x t) v.

Definition subst_co_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (g:co) : co :=
  open_co_wrt_tm (close_co_tm x g) v.

Definition subst_con_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (p:constraint) : constraint :=
  match p with Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_tm x v A) end.

Definition subst_sort_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with
  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm x v A)
  | Co p => Co (subst_con_tm x v p)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (G:context) : context :=
  map (fun b => (fst b, subst_sort_tm x v (snd b))) G.

(* substitution of a coercion for a free co-variable *)

Definition subst_tm_co (c:atom) (g:co) (t:tm) : tm :=
  open_tm_wrt_co (close_tm_co c t) g.

Definition subst_co_co (c:atom) (g:co) (h:co) : co :=
  open_co_wrt_co (close_co_co c h) g.

Definition subst_con_co (c:atom) (g:co) (p:constraint) : constraint :=
  match p with Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A) end.

Definition subst_sort_co (c:atom) (g:co) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with
  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_co c g A)
  | Co p => Co (subst_con_co c g p)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx_co (c:atom) (g:co) (G:context) : context :=
  map (fun b => (fst b, subst_sort_co c g (snd b))) G.

(* ---------- basic computation lemmas ---------- *)

Lemma subst_tm_var_eq : forall x v, subst_tm x v (a_Var_f x) = v.
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec x x) as [E|E]; [| exfalso; auto].
  rewrite (@open_var_b_eq_tm 0 v 0); auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_var_neq : forall x y v, y <> x -> subst_tm x v (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [E|E]; [congruence|].
  rewrite (@open_var_b_lt_tm 0 (a_Var_f y) 0); [reflexivity| lia].
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_star : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Star = a_Star.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_pi : forall x v rho A B,
  subst_tm x v (a_Pi rho A B) =
  a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_abs : forall x v rho A b,
  subst_tm x v (a_Abs rho A b) =
  a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_uabs : forall x v rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_UAbs rho b) = a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_app : forall x v a rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_App a rho b) = a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_conv : forall x v a g,
  subst_tm x v (a_Conv a g) = a_Conv (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, subst_co_tm, close_tm, close_co_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm, open_co_wrt_tm.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_cpi : forall x v phi B,
  subst_tm x v (a_CPi phi B) = a_CPi (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v B).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, subst_con_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_cabs : forall x v phi b,
  subst_tm x v (a_CAbs phi b) = a_CAbs (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v b).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, subst_con_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_ucabs : forall x v b,
  subst_tm x v (a_UCAbs b) = a_UCAbs (subst_tm x v b).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_capp : forall x v a g,
  subst_tm x v (a_CApp a g) = a_CApp (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_tm, subst_co_tm, close_tm, close_co_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm, open_co_wrt_tm.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_fam : forall x v F, subst_tm x v (a_Fam F) = a_Fam F.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_bullet : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Bullet = a_Bullet.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_tm, close_tm, open_tm_wrt_tm. reflexivity. Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* occurrence functions counting all atom occurrences *)
Fixpoint occ_brs (bs:brs) : atoms :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => {}
  | br_One K a b => occ_tm a \u occ_brs b
  end
with occ_tm (a:tm) : atoms :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => {}
  | a_Var_b n => {}
  | a_Var_f x => {{x}}
  | a_Abs rho A b => occ_tm A \u occ_tm b
  | a_UAbs rho b => occ_tm b
  | a_App a rho b => occ_tm a \u occ_tm b
  | a_Fam F => {}
  | a_Const T => {}
  | a_Pi rho A B => occ_tm A \u occ_tm B
  | a_Conv a g => occ_tm a \u occ_co g
  | a_CPi phi B => occ_con phi \u occ_tm B
  | a_CAbs phi b => occ_con phi \u occ_tm b
  | a_UCAbs b => occ_tm b
  | a_CApp a g => occ_tm a \u occ_co g
  | a_Bullet => {}
  | a_DataCon K => {}
  | a_Case a bs => occ_tm a \u occ_brs bs
  end
with occ_con (phi:constraint) : atoms :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A => occ_tm a \u occ_tm b \u occ_tm A
  end
with occ_co (g:co) : atoms :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => {}
  | g_Var_b n => {}
  | g_Var_f c => {{c}}
  | g_Beta a b => occ_tm a \u occ_tm b
  | g_Refl a => occ_tm a
  | g_Refl2 a b g => occ_tm a \u occ_tm b \u occ_co g
  | g_Sym g => occ_co g
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_PiFst g => occ_co g
  | g_CPiFst g => occ_co g
  | g_IsoSnd g => occ_co g
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g3 \u occ_co g4
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => occ_co g \u occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => occ_co g \u occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_co g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => occ_co g1 \u occ_tm A \u occ_co g2
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g => occ_con phi1 \u occ_con phi2 \u occ_co g
  | g_Eta a => occ_tm a
  | g_Left g g' => occ_co g \u occ_co g'
  | g_Right g g' => occ_co g \u occ_co g'
  end.
62 Occ.v
6:Fixpoint occ_brs (bs:brs) : atoms :=

Lemma dom_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v,

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Threshold-indexed well-scopedness.

   pclosed_tm nt nc t  : t is well scoped with nt free term binders
                         and nc free coercion binders.
   Binders increment the corresponding threshold.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_brs (nt nc:nat) (bs:brs) : Prop :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc b
  end
with pclosed_tm (nt nc:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b m => m < nt
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_UAbs rho b => pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_App a rho b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | a_Fam _ => True
  | a_Const _ => True
  | a_Pi rho A B => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc B
  | a_Conv a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_CPi phi B => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) B
  | a_CAbs phi b => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_UCAbs b => pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_CApp a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_DataCon _ => True
  | a_Case a bs => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc bs
  end
with pclosed_con (nt nc:nat) (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_tm nt nc A
  end
with pclosed_co (nt nc:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b m => m < nc
  | g_Var_f _ => True
  | g_Beta a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | g_Refl a => pclosed_tm nt nc a
  | g_Refl2 a b h => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Sym h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_CPiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_IsoSnd h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g4
  | g_CAppCong h g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_CPiSnd h g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h => pclosed_con nt nc phi1 /\ pclosed_con nt nc phi2 /\ pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Eta a => pclosed_tm nt nc a
  | g_Left h h' => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc h'
  | g_Right h h' => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc h'
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   Term-opening at the threshold raises the term threshold by one.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_raise_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt x t) -> pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt x t0) -> pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t0) with
  | a_Star => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Var_b m => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m nt) as [[E|E]|E];
      [ rewrite (@open_var_b_lt_tm nt x m E) in H | rewrite (@open_var_b_eq_tm nt x m E) in H
      | rewrite (@open_var_b_gt_tm nt x m E) in H ];
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; cbn [pclosed_tm]; lia)
  | a_Var_f y => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm A nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b (S nt) nc x Hb) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      exact (pclosed_raise_tm b (S nt) nc x H))
  | a_App a rho b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt nc x Hb) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Const T => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA HB];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm A nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm B (S nt) nc x HB) ])
  | a_Conv a g => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hg];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g nt nc x Hg) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [Hp HB];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_con_tm phi nt nc x Hp) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm B nt (S nc) x HB) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [Hp Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_con_tm phi nt nc x Hp) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt (S nc) x Hb) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt (S nc) x H))
  | a_CApp a g => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hg];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g nt nc x Hg) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_DataCon K => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Case a bs => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_brs_tm bs nt nc x Hb) ])
  end
with pclosed_raise_brs_tm (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_brs nt nc (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec nt x bs) -> pclosed_brs (S nt) nc bs :=
  match bs as s0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_brs nt nc (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec nt x s0) -> pclosed_brs (S nt) nc s0) with
  | br_None => fun nt nc x H => I
  | br_One K a b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_brs_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_brs] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_brs_tm b nt nc x Hb) ])
  end
with pclosed_raise_con_tm (p:constraint) {struct p} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_con nt nc (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec nt x p) -> pclosed_con (S nt) nc p :=
  match p as s0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_con nt nc (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec nt x s0) -> pclosed_con (S nt) nc s0) with
  | Eq a b A => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_con] in H; destruct H as [Ha [Hb HA]];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x Ha) |
               split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt nc x Hb) |
                        exact (pclosed_raise_tm A nt nc x HA) ] ])
  end
with pclosed_raise_co_tm (g:co) {struct g} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_co nt nc (open_co_wrt_tm_rec nt x g) -> pclosed_co (S nt) nc g :=
  match g as s0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_co nt nc (open_co_wrt_tm_rec nt x s0) -> pclosed_co (S nt) nc s0) with
  | g_Triv => fun nt nc x H => I
  | g_Var_b m => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact H)
  | g_Var_f c => fun nt nc x H => I
  | g_Beta a b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [Ha Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x Ha) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt nc x Hb) ])
  | g_Refl a => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x H))
  | g_Refl2 a b h => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [Ha [Hb Hh]];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x Ha) |
               split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt nc x Hb) |
                        exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm h nt nc x Hh) ] ])
  | g_Sym h => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm h nt nc x H))
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H2];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g2 nt nc x H2) ])
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H2];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g2 nt nc x H2) ])
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H2];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g2 nt nc x H2) ])
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H2];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g2 nt nc x H2) ])
  | g_PiFst h => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm h nt nc x H))
  | g_CPiFst h => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm h nt nc x H))
  | g_IsoSnd h => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm h nt nc x H))
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H2];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g2 nt nc x H2) ])
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 H3];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g3 nt (S nc) x H3) ])
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [H1 [H3 H4]];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g1 nt nc x H1) |
               split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g3 nt (S nc) x H3) |
                        exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g4 nt nc x H4) ] ])
  | g_CAppCong h g1 g2 => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_co] in H; destruct H as [Hh [H1 H2]];

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Threshold-indexed well-scopedness.

   pclosed_tm nt nc t  : t is well scoped with nt free term binders
                         and nc free coercion binders.
   Binders increment the corresponding threshold.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_brs (nt nc:nat) (bs:brs) : Prop :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc b
  end
with pclosed_tm (nt nc:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b m => m < nt
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_UAbs rho b => pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_App a rho b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | a_Fam _ => True
  | a_Const _ => True
  | a_Pi rho A B => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc B
  | a_Conv a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_CPi phi B => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) B
  | a_CAbs phi b => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_UCAbs b => pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_CApp a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_DataCon _ => True
  | a_Case a bs => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc bs
  end
with pclosed_con (nt nc:nat) (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_tm nt nc A
  end
with pclosed_co (nt nc:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b m => m < nc
  | g_Var_f _ => True
  | g_Beta a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | g_Refl a => pclosed_tm nt nc a
  | g_Refl2 a b h => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Sym h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_CPiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_IsoSnd h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g4
  | g_CAppCong h g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_CPiSnd h g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h => pclosed_con nt nc phi1 /\ pclosed_con nt nc phi2 /\ pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Eta a => pclosed_tm nt nc a
  | g_Left h h' => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc h'
  | g_Right h h' => pclosed_co nt nc h /\ pclosed_co nt nc h'
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   Term-opening at the threshold raises the term threshold by one.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_raise_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt x t) -> pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt x t0) -> pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t0) with
  | a_Star => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Var_b m => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m nt) as [[E|E]|E];
      [ rewrite (@open_var_b_lt_tm nt x m E) in H | rewrite (@open_var_b_eq_tm nt x m E) in H
      | rewrite (@open_var_b_gt_tm nt x m E) in H ];
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; cbn [pclosed_tm]; lia)
  | a_Var_f y => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm A nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b (S nt) nc x Hb) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      exact (pclosed_raise_tm b (S nt) nc x H))
  | a_App a rho b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt nc x Hb) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Const T => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA HB];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm A nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm B (S nt) nc x HB) ])
  | a_Conv a g => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hg];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g nt nc x Hg) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [Hp HB];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_con_tm phi nt nc x Hp) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm B nt (S nc) x HB) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [Hp Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_con_tm phi nt nc x Hp) | exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt (S nc) x Hb) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H;
      exact (pclosed_raise_tm b nt (S nc) x H))
  | a_CApp a g => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hg];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_co_tm g nt nc x Hg) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_DataCon K => fun nt nc x H => I
  | a_Case a bs => fun nt nc x H => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      split; [ exact (pclosed_raise_tm a nt nc x HA) | exact (pclosed_raise_brs_tm bs nt nc x Hb) ])
  end
with pclosed_raise_brs_tm (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (nt nc:nat) (x:atom),
    pclosed_brs nt nc (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec nt x bs) -> pclosed_brs (S nt) nc bs :=

  forall (nt nc:nat) (c:atom),
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_co_rec nc (g_Var_f c) t) -> pclosed_tm nt (S nc) t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (c:atom),

  | a_Star => fun nt nc c H => I

   (term substitution direction)

  forall (nt nc:nat) (v:tm),
    pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t -> pclosed_tm nt nc v ->
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt v t) :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat) (v:tm),
    pclosed_tm (S nt) nc t0 -> pclosed_tm nt nc v ->
    pclosed_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec nt v t0)) with
  | a_Star => fun nt nc v H Hv => I
  | a_Var_b m => fun nt nc v H Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H;
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m nt) as [[E|E]|E];
      [ rewrite (@open_var_b_lt_tm nt v m E) | rewrite (@open_var_b_eq_tm nt v m E)
      | rewrite (@open_var_b_gt_tm nt v m E) ];
      cbn [pclosed_tm]; lia || exact Hv)
  | a_Var_f y => fun nt nc v H Hv => I
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun nt nc v H Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm]; split;
      [ exact (pclosed_open_tm A nt nc v HA Hv)
      | exact (pclosed_open_tm b (S nt) nc v Hb (pclosed_mono_tm v nt nc (S nt) nc ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hv)) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun nt nc v H Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm];
      exact (pclosed_open_tm b (S nt) nc v H (pclosed_mono_tm v nt nc (S nt) nc ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hv)))
  | a_App a rho b => fun nt nc v H Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec pclosed_tm]; split;
      [ exact (pclosed_open_tm a nt nc v HA Hv)
      | exact (pclosed_open_tm b nt nc v Hb Hv) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun nt nc v H Hv => I
  | a_Const T => fun nt nc v H Hv => I
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun nt nc v H Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA HB];

      [ exact (pclosed_open_tm A nt nc v HA Hv)

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed AnnPclosed Commute Weak.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Scheme AnnTyping_wind := Induction for AnnTyping Sort Prop

 with AnnIso_wind := Induction for AnnIso Sort Prop
 with AnnDefEq_wind := Induction for AnnDefEq Sort Prop
 with AnnCtx_wind := Induction for AnnCtx Sort Prop
 with AnnSig_wind := Induction for AnnSig Sort Prop.

Lemma AnnTyping_weak : forall G0 a0 A0, AnnTyping G0 a0 A0 ->
  forall Δ G', G0 = Δ ++ G' ->
  forall Γ, AnnCtx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> AnnTyping (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') a0 A0.

  intros G0 a0 A0 d0.
  induction d0 using AnnTyping_wind with
   (P := fun G a A d => forall Δ G', G = Δ ++ G' ->
            forall Γ, AnnCtx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> AnnTyping (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') a A)
   (P0 := fun G phi d => forall Δ G', G = Δ ++ G' ->
            forall Γ, AnnCtx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> AnnPropWff (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') phi)
   (P1 := fun G D g p1 p2 d => forall Δ G', G = Δ ++ G' ->

   (P2 := fun G D g a b d => forall Δ G', G = Δ ++ G' ->
            forall Γ, AnnCtx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> AnnDefEq (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') D g a b)

    + intros x Hx.
      assert (HxL : x \notin L) by fsetdec.

    + exact HA'.
    + intros x Hx.

      assert (Wx : AnnCtx (((x ~ Tm A) ++ Δ) ++ Γ ++ G')) by (apply An_ConsTm; [ exact W | exact HA' | exact Hxd ]).

    + intros x Hx. apply HR. fsetdec.
  - (* An_App *) intros G b rho a0 B A Htyp IHtyp Ha IHa Δ G' E Γ W. subst G.

Inductive AnnPropWff : context -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnPropWff *)
 | An_Wff : forall (G:context) (a b A B:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnTyping G b B ->
      (  (erase_tm  A )   =   (erase_tm  B )  )  ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a b A)
with AnnTyping : context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnTyping *)
 | An_Star : forall (G:context),
     AnnCtx G ->

 | An_Var : forall (G:context) (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->

 | An_Pi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),

      ( AnnTyping G A a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A B) a_Star
 | An_Abs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A a B:tm),
      ( AnnTyping G A a_Star )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  (erase_tm   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Abs rho A a) (a_Pi rho A B)
 | An_App : forall (G:context) (b:tm) (rho:relflag) (a B A:tm),

 | An_Conv : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (g:co) (B A:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->

     AnnTyping G (a_Conv a g) B
 | An_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
      ( AnnPropWff G phi )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi B) a_Star
 | An_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (phi:constraint) (a B:tm),
      ( AnnPropWff G phi )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CAbs phi a) (a_CPi phi B)
 | An_CApp : forall (G:context) (a1:tm) (g:co) (B a b A1:tm),
     AnnTyping G a1 (a_CPi (Eq a b A1) B) ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g a b ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CApp a1 g)  (open_tm_wrt_co  B   g )

     AnnTyping G (a_Fam F) A

 | An_PropCong : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->

     AnnPropWff G (Eq A2 B2 A) ->
     AnnIso G D  ( (g_EqCong g1 A g2) )   ( (Eq A1 B1 A) )   ( (Eq A2 B2 A) )
 | An_CPiFst : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (phi1 phi2:constraint) (A2 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g (a_CPi phi1 A2) (a_CPi phi2 B2) ->
     AnnIso G D (g_CPiFst g) phi1 phi2
 | An_IsoSym : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (phi2 phi1:constraint),
     AnnIso G D g phi1 phi2 ->
     AnnIso G D (g_Sym g) phi2 phi1

     AnnDefEq G D g A B ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a1 a2 A) ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a1' a2' B) ->
      (  (erase_tm  a1 )   =   (erase_tm  a1' )  )  ->
      (  (erase_tm  a2 )   =   (erase_tm  a2' )  )  ->
     AnnIso G D (g_IsoConv  ( (Eq a1 a2 A) )   ( (Eq a1' a2' B) )  g)  ( (Eq a1 a2 A) )   ( (Eq a1' a2' B) )
with AnnDefEq : context -> available_props -> co -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnDefEq *)
 | An_Assn : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (c:covar) (a b A:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->
      binds  c  (Co  (Eq a b A) )  G  ->
      AtomSetImpl.In  c   D  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Var_f c) a b
 | An_Refl : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a A:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Refl a) a a

     AnnTyping G b B ->
      (  (erase_tm  a )   =   (erase_tm  b )  )  ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g A B ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Refl2 a b g) a b
 | An_Sym : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (a b B A:tm) (g1:co),

     AnnTyping G a A ->

     AnnDefEq G D g b a ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Sym g) a b

      ( AnnTyping G a A )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G a1 A1 )  ->
      ( AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g3 A A1 )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D  ( (g_Trans g1 g2) )  a b
 | An_Beta : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 B0 B1:tm),
     AnnTyping G a1 B0 ->
     AnnTyping G a2 B1 ->
      (  (erase_tm  B0 )   =   (erase_tm  B1 )  )  ->
     Beta  (erase_tm  a1 )   (erase_tm  a2 )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Beta a1 a2) a1 a2
 | An_PiCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (g1 g2:co) (A1 B1 A2 B3 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( x ~ Tm  A1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_tm g2 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )    (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   (a_Var_f x) )   )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B3 (a_Var_f x) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   (a_Conv (a_Var_f x) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A1 B1) a_Star ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A1 B2) a_Star ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A2 B3) a_Star ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_PiCong rho g1 g2)  ( (a_Pi rho A1 B1) )   ( (a_Pi rho A2 B3) )
 | An_AbsCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (g1 g2:co) (A1 b1 A2 b3 b2 B:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( x ~ Tm  A1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_tm g2 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )    (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Var_f x) )   )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b3 (a_Var_f x) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Conv (a_Var_f x) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G A1 a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G A2 a_Star ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  (erase_tm   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  )  ->

82	Fixpoint subst_brs_co (c:atom) (g:co) (bs:brs) {struct bs} : brs :=
83	  match bs with
84	  | br_None => br_None
85	  | br_One K a b => br_One K (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_brs_co c g b)
86	  end
87	with subst_tm_co (c:atom) (g:co) (t:tm) {struct t} : tm :=
88	  match t with
89	  | a_Star => a_Star
90	  | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
91	  | a_Var_f y => a_Var_f y
92	  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g b)
93	  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (subst_tm_co c g b)
94	  | a_App a rho b => a_App (subst_tm_co c g a) rho (subst_tm_co c g b)
95	  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
96	  | a_Const T => a_Const T
97	  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g B)
98	  | a_Conv a h => a_Conv (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_co_co c g h)
99	  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g B)
100	  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g b)
101	  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (subst_tm_co c g b)
102	  | a_CApp a h => a_CApp (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_co_co c g h)
103	  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
104	  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
105	  | a_Case a bs => a_Case (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_brs_co c g bs)
106	  end
107	with subst_con_co (c:atom) (g:co) (p:constraint) {struct p} : constraint :=
108	  match p with
109	  | Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A)
110	  end
111	with subst_co_co (c:atom) (g:co) (h:co) {struct h} : co :=
112	  match h with
113	  | g_Triv => g_Triv
114	  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
115	  | g_Var_f d => if KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c then g else g_Var_f d
116	  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b)
117	  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (subst_tm_co c g a)
118	  | g_Refl2 a b h' => g_Refl2 (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_co_co c g h')
119	  | g_Sym h' => g_Sym (subst_co_co c g h')
120	  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
121	  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
122	  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
123	  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => g_AppCong (subst_co_co c g g1) rho (subst_co_co c g g2)
124	  | g_PiFst h' => g_PiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
125	  | g_CPiFst h' => g_CPiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
126	  | g_IsoSnd h' => g_IsoSnd (subst_co_co c g h')
127	  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
128	  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3)
129	  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3) (subst_co_co c g g4)
130	  | g_CAppCong h' g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
131	  | g_CPiSnd h' g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
132	  | g_Cast g1 g2 => g_Cast (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
133	  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_co_co c g g2)
134	  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h' => g_IsoConv (subst_con_co c g phi1) (subst_con_co c g phi2) (subst_co_co c g h')
135	  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (subst_tm_co c g a)
136	  | g_Left h' h'' => g_Left (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
137	  | g_Right h' h'' => g_Right (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
138	  end.
139	
140	Definition subst_sort_co (c:atom) (g:co) (s:sort) : sort :=
141	  match s with
142	  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_co c g A)
143	  | Co p => Co (subst_con_co c g p)
144	  end.
145	
146	Definition subst_ctx_co (c:atom) (g:co) (G:context) : context :=
147	  List.map (fun b : atom * sort => (fst b, subst_sort_co c g (snd b))) G.
148	
149	(* =====================================================================
150	   Structural equations (definitional).
151	   ===================================================================== *)
152	
153	Lemma subst_tm_var_eq : forall x v, subst_tm x v (a_Var_f x) = v.
154	Proof.
155	  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec x x) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
156	Qed.
157	Lemma subst_tm_var_neq : forall x y v, y <> x -> subst_tm x v (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
158	Proof.
159	  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [E|E]; [congruence|reflexivity].
160	Qed.
161	Lemma subst_tm_star : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Star = a_Star.
162	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
163	Lemma subst_tm_var_b : forall x v n, subst_tm x v (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
164	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
165	Lemma subst_tm_pi : forall x v rho A B,
166	  subst_tm x v (a_Pi rho A B) = a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B).
167	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
168	Lemma subst_tm_abs : forall x v rho A b,
169	  subst_tm x v (a_Abs rho A b) = a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b).
170	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
171	Lemma subst_tm_uabs : forall x v rho b,
172	  subst_tm x v (a_UAbs rho b) = a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b).
173	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
174	Lemma subst_tm_app : forall x v a rho b,
175	  subst_tm x v (a_App a rho b) = a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b).
176	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
177	Lemma subst_tm_conv : forall x v a g,
178	  subst_tm x v (a_Conv a g) = a_Conv (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
179	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
180	Lemma subst_tm_cpi : forall x v phi B,
181	  subst_tm x v (a_CPi phi B) = a_CPi (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v B).
182	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
183	Lemma subst_tm_cabs : forall x v phi b,
184	  subst_tm x v (a_CAbs phi b) = a_CAbs (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v b).
185	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
186	Lemma subst_tm_ucabs : forall x v b,
187	  subst_tm x v (a_UCAbs b) = a_UCAbs (subst_tm x v b).
188	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
189	Lemma subst_tm_capp : forall x v a g,
190	  subst_tm x v (a_CApp a g) = a_CApp (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
191	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
192	Lemma subst_tm_fam : forall x v F, subst_tm x v (a_Fam F) = a_Fam F.
193	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
194	Lemma subst_tm_bullet : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Bullet = a_Bullet.
195	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
196	Lemma subst_tm_datacon : forall x v K, subst_tm x v (a_DataCon K) = a_DataCon K.
197	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
198	Lemma subst_tm_case : forall x v a bs,
199	  subst_tm x v (a_Case a bs) = a_Case (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v bs).
200	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
201	Lemma subst_con_eq : forall x v a b A,
202	  subst_con_tm x v (Eq a b A) = Eq (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_tm x v A).
203	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
204	
205	Lemma subst_co_co_var_eq : forall c g, subst_co_co c g (g_Var_f c) = g.
206	Proof.
207	  intros. cbn [subst_co_co]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec c c) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
208	Qed.
209	Lemma subst_co_co_var_neq : forall c d g, d <> c -> subst_co_co c g (g_Var_f d) = g_Var_f d.
210	Proof.
211	  intros. cbn [subst_co_co]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c) as [E|E]; [congruence|reflexivity].
212	Qed.
213	Lemma subst_tm_co_var_f : forall c g y, subst_tm_co c g (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
214	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
215	Lemma subst_tm_co_star : forall c g, subst_tm_co c g a_Star = a_Star.
216	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
217	Lemma subst_tm_co_pi : forall c g rho A B,
218	  subst_tm_co c g (a_Pi rho A B) = a_Pi rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g B).
219	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
220	Lemma subst_tm_co_cpi : forall c g phi B,
221	  subst_tm_co c g (a_CPi phi B) = a_CPi (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g B).
222	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
223	Lemma subst_con_co_eq : forall c g a b A,
224	  subst_con_co c g (Eq a b A) = Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A).
225	Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
226	
227	(* =====================================================================
228	   Substitution is the identity on terms that do not mention the
229	   substituted variable.
230	   ===================================================================== *)
231	
232	Ltac sid :=
233	  first [
234	    match goal with
235	    | H : ?z \notin {{?y}} |- (if KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?y ?z then _ else a_Var_f ?y) = a_Var_f ?y =>
236	        destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y z) as [E|E];
237	        [exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity]
238	    end
239	  | match goal with
240	    | H : ?z \notin {{?c}} |- (if KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?c ?z then _ else g_Var_f ?c) = g_Var_f ?c =>
241	        destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec c z) as [E|E];
242	        [exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity]
243	    end
244	  | match goal with
245	    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
246	        match goal with
247	        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_tm ?u -> subst_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
248	            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
249	        end
250	    end
251	  | match goal with
252	    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_brs_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
253	        match goal with
254	        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_brs ?u -> subst_brs_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
255	            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
256	        end
257	    end
258	  | match goal with
259	    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_con_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
260	        match goal with
261	        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_con ?u -> subst_con_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
262	            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
263	        end
264	    end
265	  | match goal with
266	    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_co_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
267	        match goal with
268	        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_co ?u -> subst_co_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
269	            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
270	        end
271	    end
272	  | match goal with
273	    | Htm : forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t
274	           |- subst_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
275	        apply (Htm u z w); fsetdec
276	    end
277	  | match goal with
278	    | Hbrs : forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs
279	            |- subst_brs_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
280	        apply (Hbrs u z w); fsetdec
281	    end
282	  | match goal with
283	    | Hcon : forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p
284	            |- subst_con_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
285	        apply (Hcon u z w); fsetdec
286	    end
287	  | match goal with
288	    | Hco : forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g
289	           |- subst_co_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
290	        apply (Hco u z w); fsetdec
291	    end
292	  | reflexivity
293	  | progress (f_equal); sid ].
294	
295	Lemma subst_id_mut :
296	  ((forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t) /\
297	   (forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs) /\
298	   (forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p) /\
299	   (forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)).
300	Proof.
301	  assert (Htm : forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t).
302	  { intros tt xx vv. revert xx vv.
303	    apply tm_mut with
304	      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
305	      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
306	      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
307	      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
308	    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
309	                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
310	    all: sid. }
311	  assert (Hbrs : forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs).
312	  { intros bb xx vv. revert xx vv.
313	    apply brs_mut with
314	      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
315	      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
316	      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
317	      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
318	    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
319	                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
320	    all: sid. }
321	  assert (Hcon : forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
322	  { intros [a b A] x v H. cbn [occ_con subst_con_tm] in *.
323	    sid. }
324	  assert (Hco : forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g).
325	  { intros gg xx vv. revert xx vv.
326	    apply co_mut with
327	      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
328	      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
329	      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
330	      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
331	    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
332	                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
333	    all: sid. }
334	  repeat split; assumption.
335	Qed.
336	
337	(* =====================================================================
338	   Context substitution: basic interaction with binds / dom.
339	   ===================================================================== *)
340	
341	Lemma dom_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v,
342	  dom (subst_ctx_tm x v G) = dom G.
343	Proof.
344	  intros G. induction G as [|[z s] G IH]; intros x v; simpl; [reflexivity|].
345	  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
346	Qed.
347	
348	Lemma dom_subst_ctx_co : forall G c g,
349	  dom (subst_ctx_co c g G) = dom G.
350	Proof.
351	  intros G. induction G as [|[z s] G IH]; intros c g; simpl; [reflexivity|].
352	  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
353	Qed.
354	
355	Lemma binds_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v y s,
356	  binds y s (subst_ctx_tm x v G) ->
357	  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_tm x v s'.
358	Proof.
359	  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
360	  - simpl in H. inversion H.
361	  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
362	    destruct H as [E|H].
363	    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
364	    + destruct (IH x v y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
365	Qed.
366	
367	Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co : forall G c g y s,
368	  binds y s (subst_ctx_co c g G) ->
369	  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_co c g s'.
370	Proof.
371	  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros c g y s H.
372	  - simpl in H. inversion H.
373	  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
374	    destruct H as [E|H].
375	    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
376	    + destruct (IH c g y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
377	Qed.
378	
379	Lemma binds_subst_ctx_tm_fwd : forall G x v y s,
380	  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_tm x v s) (subst_ctx_tm x v G).
381	Proof.
382	  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
383	  - simpl in H. inversion H.
384	  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
385	    + inversion E. subst. left; reflexivity.
386	    + right. apply IH. exact H.
387	Qed.
388	
389	Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co_fwd : forall G c g y s,
390	  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_co c g s) (subst_ctx_co c g G).
391	Proof.
392	  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros c g y s H.
393	  - simpl in H. inversion H.
394	  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
395	    + inversion E. subst. left; reflexivity.
396	    + right. apply IH. exact H.
397	Qed.
398	
399	Lemma binds_app : forall (A B:context) y s,
400	  binds y s (A ++ B) -> binds y s A \/ binds y s B.
401	Proof.
402	  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B y s H.
403	  - simpl in H. right. exact H.
404	  - simpl in H. destruct H as [E|H].
405	    + left. left. exact E.
406	    + destruct (IH B y s H) as [HA|HB].
407	      * left. right. exact HA.
408	      * right. exact HB.
409	Qed.
410	
411	Lemma subst_ctx_tm_app : forall G1 G2 x v,
412	  subst_ctx_tm x v (G1 ++ G2) = subst_ctx_tm x v G1 ++ subst_ctx_tm x v G2.
413	Proof.
414	  intros. unfold subst_ctx_tm. apply List.map_app.
415	Qed.
416	
417	Lemma subst_ctx_co_app : forall G1 G2 c g,
418	  subst_ctx_co c g (G1 ++ G2) = subst_ctx_co c g G1 ++ subst_ctx_co c g G2.
419	Proof.
420	  intros. unfold subst_ctx_co. apply List.map_app.
421	Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Capture-avoiding substitution of a term for a free term variable.
   Binders are de Bruijn, so no shifting is needed: recursion is
   purely structural.  Free atoms are never captured by binders.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint subst_brs_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (bs:brs) {struct bs} : brs :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a b => br_One K (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v b)
  end
with subst_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (t:tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
  | a_Var_f y => if KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x then v else a_Var_f y
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_App a rho b => a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Const T => a_Const T
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B)
  | a_Conv a g => a_Conv (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a bs => a_Case (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v bs)
  end
with subst_con_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (p:constraint) {struct p} : constraint :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_tm x v A)
  end
with subst_co_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (g:co) {struct g} : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
  | g_Var_f c => g_Var_f c
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (subst_tm x v a)
  | g_Refl2 a b h => g_Refl2 (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Sym h => g_Sym (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => g_AppCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) rho (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_PiFst h => g_PiFst (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_CPiFst h => g_CPiFst (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_IsoSnd h => g_IsoSnd (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g3) (subst_co_tm x v g4)
  | g_CAppCong h g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_CPiSnd h g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => g_Cast (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_tm x v A) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h => g_IsoConv (subst_con_tm x v phi1) (subst_con_tm x v phi2) (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (subst_tm x v a)
  | g_Left h h' => g_Left (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v h')
  | g_Right h h' => g_Right (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v h')
  end.

Definition subst_sort_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with
  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm x v A)
  | Co p => Co (subst_con_tm x v p)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (G:context) : context :=
  List.map (fun b : atom * sort => (fst b, subst_sort_tm x v (snd b))) G.

(* =====================================================================
   Substitution of a coercion for a free co-variable.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint subst_brs_co (c:atom) (g:co) (bs:brs) {struct bs} : brs :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a b => br_One K (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_brs_co c g b)
  end
with subst_tm_co (c:atom) (g:co) (t:tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
  | a_Var_f y => a_Var_f y
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_App a rho b => a_App (subst_tm_co c g a) rho (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Const T => a_Const T
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g B)
  | a_Conv a h => a_Conv (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_co_co c g h)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | a_CApp a h => a_CApp (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_co_co c g h)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a bs => a_Case (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_brs_co c g bs)
  end
with subst_con_co (c:atom) (g:co) (p:constraint) {struct p} : constraint :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A)
  end
with subst_co_co (c:atom) (g:co) (h:co) {struct h} : co :=
  match h with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
  | g_Var_f d => if KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c then g else g_Var_f d
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (subst_tm_co c g a)
  | g_Refl2 a b h' => g_Refl2 (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Sym h' => g_Sym (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => g_AppCong (subst_co_co c g g1) rho (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_PiFst h' => g_PiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_CPiFst h' => g_CPiFst (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_IsoSnd h' => g_IsoSnd (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g3) (subst_co_co c g g4)
  | g_CAppCong h' g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_CPiSnd h' g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => g_Cast (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (subst_co_co c g g1) (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_co_co c g g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h' => g_IsoConv (subst_con_co c g phi1) (subst_con_co c g phi2) (subst_co_co c g h')
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (subst_tm_co c g a)
  | g_Left h' h'' => g_Left (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
  | g_Right h' h'' => g_Right (subst_co_co c g h') (subst_co_co c g h'')
  end.

Definition subst_sort_co (c:atom) (g:co) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with
  | Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_co c g A)
  | Co p => Co (subst_con_co c g p)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx_co (c:atom) (g:co) (G:context) : context :=
  List.map (fun b : atom * sort => (fst b, subst_sort_co c g (snd b))) G.

(* =====================================================================
   Structural equations (definitional).
   ===================================================================== *)

Lemma subst_tm_var_eq : forall x v, subst_tm x v (a_Var_f x) = v.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec x x) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_var_neq : forall x y v, y <> x -> subst_tm x v (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_tm]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [E|E]; [congruence|reflexivity].
Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_star : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Star = a_Star.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_var_b : forall x v n, subst_tm x v (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_pi : forall x v rho A B,
  subst_tm x v (a_Pi rho A B) = a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_abs : forall x v rho A b,
  subst_tm x v (a_Abs rho A b) = a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_uabs : forall x v rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_UAbs rho b) = a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_app : forall x v a rho b,
  subst_tm x v (a_App a rho b) = a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_conv : forall x v a g,
  subst_tm x v (a_Conv a g) = a_Conv (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_cpi : forall x v phi B,
  subst_tm x v (a_CPi phi B) = a_CPi (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v B).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_cabs : forall x v phi b,
  subst_tm x v (a_CAbs phi b) = a_CAbs (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_ucabs : forall x v b,
  subst_tm x v (a_UCAbs b) = a_UCAbs (subst_tm x v b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_capp : forall x v a g,
  subst_tm x v (a_CApp a g) = a_CApp (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_fam : forall x v F, subst_tm x v (a_Fam F) = a_Fam F.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_bullet : forall x v, subst_tm x v a_Bullet = a_Bullet.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_datacon : forall x v K, subst_tm x v (a_DataCon K) = a_DataCon K.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_case : forall x v a bs,
  subst_tm x v (a_Case a bs) = a_Case (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v bs).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_con_eq : forall x v a b A,
  subst_con_tm x v (Eq a b A) = Eq (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_tm x v A).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_co_co_var_eq : forall c g, subst_co_co c g (g_Var_f c) = g.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_co_co]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec c c) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
Qed.
Lemma subst_co_co_var_neq : forall c d g, d <> c -> subst_co_co c g (g_Var_f d) = g_Var_f d.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [subst_co_co]. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c) as [E|E]; [congruence|reflexivity].
Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_co_var_f : forall c g y, subst_tm_co c g (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_co_star : forall c g, subst_tm_co c g a_Star = a_Star.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_co_pi : forall c g rho A B,
  subst_tm_co c g (a_Pi rho A B) = a_Pi rho (subst_tm_co c g A) (subst_tm_co c g B).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_tm_co_cpi : forall c g phi B,
  subst_tm_co c g (a_CPi phi B) = a_CPi (subst_con_co c g phi) (subst_tm_co c g B).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma subst_con_co_eq : forall c g a b A,
  subst_con_co c g (Eq a b A) = Eq (subst_tm_co c g a) (subst_tm_co c g b) (subst_tm_co c g A).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* =====================================================================
   Substitution is the identity on terms that do not mention the
   substituted variable.
   ===================================================================== *)

Ltac sid :=
  first [
    match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin {{?y}} |- (if KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?y ?z then _ else a_Var_f ?y) = a_Var_f ?y =>
        destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y z) as [E|E];
        [exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity]
    end
  | match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin {{?c}} |- (if KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?c ?z then _ else g_Var_f ?c) = g_Var_f ?c =>
        destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec c z) as [E|E];
        [exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity]
    end
  | match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        match goal with
        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_tm ?u -> subst_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
        end
    end
  | match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_brs_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        match goal with
        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_brs ?u -> subst_brs_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
        end
    end
  | match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_con_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        match goal with
        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_con ?u -> subst_con_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
        end
    end
  | match goal with
    | H : ?z \notin ?S |- subst_co_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        match goal with
        | IH : forall x v, x \notin occ_co ?u -> subst_co_tm x v ?u = ?u |- _ =>
            apply (IH z w); fsetdec
        end
    end
  | match goal with
    | Htm : forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t
           |- subst_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        apply (Htm u z w); fsetdec
    end
  | match goal with
    | Hbrs : forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs
            |- subst_brs_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        apply (Hbrs u z w); fsetdec
    end
  | match goal with
    | Hcon : forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p
            |- subst_con_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        apply (Hcon u z w); fsetdec
    end
  | match goal with
    | Hco : forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g
           |- subst_co_tm ?z ?w ?u = ?u =>
        apply (Hco u z w); fsetdec
    end
  | reflexivity
  | progress (f_equal); sid ].

Lemma subst_id_mut :
  ((forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t) /\
   (forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs) /\
   (forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p) /\
   (forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)).
Proof.
  assert (Htm : forall (t:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t).
  { intros tt xx vv. revert xx vv.
    apply tm_mut with
      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
    all: sid. }
  assert (Hbrs : forall (bs:brs) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs).
  { intros bb xx vv. revert xx vv.
    apply brs_mut with
      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
    all: sid. }
  assert (Hcon : forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
  { intros [a b A] x v H. cbn [occ_con subst_con_tm] in *.
    sid. }
  assert (Hco : forall (g:co) (x:atom) (v:tm), x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g).
  { intros gg xx vv. revert xx vv.
    apply co_mut with
      (P  := fun t => forall x v, x \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm x v t = t)
      (P0 := fun bs => forall x v, x \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_tm x v bs = bs)
      (P1 := fun g => forall x v, x \notin occ_co g -> subst_co_tm x v g = g)
      (P2 := fun p => forall x v, x \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_tm x v p = p).
    all: intros; cbn [occ_tm occ_brs occ_co occ_con
                       subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm] in *.
    all: sid. }
  repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(* =====================================================================
   Context substitution: basic interaction with binds / dom.
   ===================================================================== *)

Lemma dom_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v,
  dom (subst_ctx_tm x v G) = dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z s] G IH]; intros x v; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_subst_ctx_co : forall G c g,
  dom (subst_ctx_co c g G) = dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z s] G IH]; intros c g; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v y s,
  binds y s (subst_ctx_tm x v G) ->
  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_tm x v s'.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
    + destruct (IH x v y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co : forall G c g y s,
  binds y s (subst_ctx_co c g G) ->
  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_co c g s'.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros c g y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
    + destruct (IH c g y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_tm_fwd : forall G x v y s,
  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_tm x v s) (subst_ctx_tm x v G).
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. left; reflexivity.
    + right. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co_fwd : forall G c g y s,
  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_co c g s) (subst_ctx_co c g G).
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros c g y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. left; reflexivity.
    + right. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_app : forall (A B:context) y s,
  binds y s (A ++ B) -> binds y s A \/ binds y s B.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B y s H.
  - simpl in H. right. exact H.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [E|H].
    + left. left. exact E.
    + destruct (IH B y s H) as [HA|HB].
      * left. right. exact HA.
      * right. exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_tm_app : forall G1 G2 x v,
  subst_ctx_tm x v (G1 ++ G2) = subst_ctx_tm x v G1 ++ subst_ctx_tm x v G2.
Proof.

 | g_EqCong (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co)

 | g_Eta (a:tm)
 | g_Left (g:co) (g':co)
 | g_Right (g:co) (g':co)
with constraint : Set :=  (*r props *)
 | Eq (a:tm) (b:tm) (A:tm).

Inductive sort : Set :=  (*r binding classifier *)
 | Tm (A:tm)
 | Co (phi:constraint).

Inductive sig_sort : Set :=  (*r signature classifier *)
 | Cs (A:tm)
 | Ax (a:tm) (A:tm).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

Definition available_props : Type := atoms.

Definition sig : Set := list (atom * sig_sort).

(* EXPERIMENTAL *)
(** auxiliary functions on the new list types *)
(** library functions *)
(** subrules *)
(** arities *)
(** opening up abstractions *)
Fixpoint open_brs_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (brs_6:brs) {struct brs_6}: brs :=
  match brs_6 with
  | br_None => br_None
  | (br_One K a brs5) => br_One K (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k a5 brs5)
end
with open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Abs rho A b) => a_Abs rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_UAbs rho b) => a_UAbs rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_App a rho b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Fam F) => a_Fam F
  | (a_Const T) => a_Const T
  | (a_Pi rho A B) => a_Pi rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Conv a g) => a_Conv (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | (a_CPi phi B) => a_CPi (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k a5 phi) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | (a_CAbs phi b) => a_CAbs (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k a5 phi) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_UCAbs b) => a_UCAbs (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_CApp a g) => a_CApp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | (a_DataCon K) => a_DataCon K
  | (a_Case a brs5) => a_Case (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k a5 brs5)
end
with open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (phi5:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A) => Eq (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)

  | (g_PiCong rho g1 g2) => g_PiCong rho (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 g2)
  | (g_AbsCong rho g1 g2) => g_AbsCong rho (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 g2)
  | (g_AppCong g1 rho g2) => g_AppCong (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) rho (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g2)
  | (g_PiFst g) => g_PiFst (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | (g_CPiFst g) => g_CPiFst (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | (g_IsoSnd g) => g_IsoSnd (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | (g_PiSnd g1 g2) => g_PiSnd (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g2)
  | (g_CPiCong g1 g3) => g_CPiCong (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g3)
  | (g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4) => g_CAbsCong (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g3) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g4)

  | (g_CPiSnd g g1 g2) => g_CPiSnd (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g2)
  | (g_Cast g1 g2) => g_Cast (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g2)
  | (g_EqCong g1 A g2) => g_EqCong (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g2)
  | (g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g) => g_IsoConv (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k a5 phi1) (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k a5 phi2) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | (g_Eta a) => g_Eta (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (g_Left g g') => g_Left (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g')
  | (g_Right g g') => g_Right (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g')
end.

===
Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Threshold-indexed well-scopedness.

   pclosed_tm nt nc t  : t is well scoped with nt free term binders
                         and nc free coercion binders.
   Binders increment the corresponding threshold.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_brs (nt nc:nat) (bs:brs) : Prop :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc b
  end
with pclosed_tm (nt nc:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b m => m < nt
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_UAbs rho b => pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_App a rho b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | a_Fam _ => True
  | a_Const _ => True
  | a_Pi rho A B => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc B
  | a_Conv a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_CPi phi B => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) B
  | a_CAbs phi b => pclosed_con nt nc phi /\ pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_UCAbs b => pclosed_tm nt (S nc) b
  | a_CApp a g => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_co nt nc g
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_DataCon _ => True
  | a_Case a bs => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc bs
  end
with pclosed_con (nt nc:nat) (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_tm nt nc A
  end
with pclosed_co (nt nc:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b m => m < nc
  | g_Var_f _ => True
  | g_Beta a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | g_Refl a => pclosed_tm nt nc a
  | g_Refl2 a b h => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b /\ pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Sym h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co (S nt) nc g2
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co (S nt) nc g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_PiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_CPiFst h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_IsoSnd h => pclosed_co nt nc h
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => pclosed_co nt nc g1 /\ pclosed_co nt (S nc) g3 /\ pclosed_co nt nc g4

(* =====================================================================
   Well-scopedness implies that opening (at a level at or above the
   threshold) is the identity.  Term-opening version.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pid_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (nt nc:nat), pclosed_tm nt nc t ->
    forall k, nt <= k -> forall u, open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u t = t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat), pclosed_tm nt nc t0 ->
    forall k, nt <= k -> forall u, open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u t0 = t0) with
  | a_Star => fun nt nc H k Hk u => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun nt nc H k Hk u => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; rewrite (@open_var_b_lt_tm k u m (Nat.lt_le_trans m nt k H Hk)); reflexivity)
  | a_Var_f y => fun nt nc H k Hk u => eq_refl
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun nt nc H k Hk u => ltac:(
      cbn [pclosed_tm] in H; destruct H as [HA Hb];
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec]; f_equal;
      [ exact (pid_tm A nt nc HA k Hk u)
      | exact (pid_tm b (S nt) nc Hb (S k) (le_n_S nt k Hk) u) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun nt nc H k Hk u => ltac:(
===
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pic_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (nt nc:nat), pclosed_tm nt nc t ->
    forall k, nc <= k -> forall g, open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g t = t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (nt nc:nat), pclosed_tm nt nc t0 ->
