Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Term substitution commutes with term-opening at an ARBITRARY term
   argument (the existing so_tm only handles opening at a free atom).
   The substituted term must be closed for de Bruijn indices.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint g1_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k w t) =
    open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_tm x v t) :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k w t0) =
    open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_tm x v t0)) with
  | a_Star => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m k) as [[E|E]|E]; cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; reflexivity)
  | a_Var_f z => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec z x) as [E|E];
      [ subst z; rewrite (@pid_tm v 0 0 Hv k (Nat.le_0_l k) (subst_tm x v w)); reflexivity
      | reflexivity ])
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm A x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v (S k) w Hv) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g1_tm b x v (S k) w Hv))
  | a_App a rho b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Const T => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm A x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm B x v (S k) w Hv) ])
  | a_Conv a g => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_co g x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_con phi x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm B x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_con phi x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv))
  | a_CApp a g => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_co g x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_DataCon K => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Case a bs => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_brs bs x v k w Hv) ])
  end
with g1_brs (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_brs_tm x v (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k w bs) =
    open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_brs_tm x v bs) :=
  match bs as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_brs_tm x v (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k w s0) =
    open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_brs_tm x v s0)) with
  | br_None => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | br_One K a b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_brs_wrt_tm_rec subst_brs_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_brs b x v k w Hv) ])
  end
with g1_con (p:constraint) {struct p} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_con_tm x v (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k w p) =
    open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_con_tm x v p) :=
  match p as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_con_tm x v (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k w s0) =
    open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_con_tm x v s0)) with
  | Eq a b A => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec subst_con_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv)
      | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv)
      | exact (g1_tm A x v k w Hv) ])
  end

  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_co_tm x v (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k w g) =
    open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_co_tm x v g) :=
  match g as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_co_tm x v (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k w s0) =
    open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_co_tm x v s0)) with
  | g_Triv => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | g_Var_b m => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | g_Var_f c => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | g_Beta a b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv) ])
  | g_Refl a => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv))
  | g_Refl2 a b h => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv)
      | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv)
      | exact (g1_co h x v k w Hv) ])
  | g_Sym h => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g1_co h x v k w Hv))
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_co g1 x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_co g2 x v k w Hv) ])
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_co g1 x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_co g2 x v (S k) w Hv) ])
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(

  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(

      [ exact (g1_co g1 x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_co g2 x v k w Hv) ])
  | g_PiFst h => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_tm_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Term substitution commutes with coercion-opening at an ARBITRARY
   coercion argument.  (soc_tm only handles opening at a free atom.)
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint g2_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h t) =
    open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_tm x v t) :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h t0) =
    open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_tm x v t0)) with
  | a_Star => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_f z => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec z x) as [E|E];
      [ subst z; rewrite (@pic_tm v 0 0 Hv k (Nat.le_0_l k) (subst_co_tm x v h)); reflexivity
      | reflexivity ])
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm A x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv))
  | a_App a rho b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Const T => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm A x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm B x v k h Hv) ])
  | a_Conv a g => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_co g x v k h Hv) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_con phi x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm B x v (S k) h Hv) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_con phi x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm b x v (S k) h Hv) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g2_tm b x v (S k) h Hv))
  | a_CApp a g => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_co g x v k h Hv) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_DataCon K => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Case a bs => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_brs bs x v k h Hv) ])
  end
with g2_brs (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_brs_tm x v (open_brs_wrt_co_rec k h bs) =
    open_brs_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_brs_tm x v bs) :=
  match bs as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_brs_tm x v (open_brs_wrt_co_rec k h s0) =
    open_brs_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_brs_tm x v s0)) with
  | br_None => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | br_One K a b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_brs_wrt_co_rec subst_brs_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_brs b x v k h Hv) ])
  end

  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_con_tm x v (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k h p) =
    open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_con_tm x v p) :=
  match p as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_con_tm x v (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k h s0) =
    open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_con_tm x v s0)) with
  | Eq a b A => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_constraint_wrt_co_rec subst_con_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv)
      | exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv)
      | exact (g2_tm A x v k h Hv) ])
  end
with g2_co (g:co) {struct g} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_co_tm x v (open_co_wrt_co_rec k h g) =
    open_co_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v g) :=
  match g as s0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_co_tm x v (open_co_wrt_co_rec k h s0) =
    open_co_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v s0)) with
  | g_Triv => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | g_Var_b m => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm];
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m k) as [[E|E]|E]; cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; reflexivity)
  | g_Var_f c => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | g_Beta a b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv) ])
  | g_Refl a => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv))
  | g_Refl2 a b hh => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_tm a x v k h Hv)
      | exact (g2_tm b x v k h Hv)
      | exact (g2_co hh x v k h Hv) ])
  | g_Sym hh => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g2_co hh x v k h Hv))
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_co g1 x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_co g2 x v k h Hv) ])
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g2_co g1 x v k h Hv) | exact (g2_co g2 x v k h Hv) ])
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec subst_co_tm]; f_equal;

All four general commutations compile. Now OpenSubst: the identity `subst x v (open t x) = open t v` when x is not free in t. We need this for term substitution and for co substitution.

Define `occ_sort` and `occ_context`? For the HxG' hypothesis in the substitution lemma, we can state it as `forall y s, binds y s G' -> x \notin occ_sort s` and then use a "substitution is identity on sort" lemma. Alternatively state directly `forall y s, binds y s G' -> subst_sort_tm x v s = s`. The latter is more directly usable. Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed AnnPclosed Commute Weak Weak2 WeakDF3.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Replacing the available-prop set D by a smaller D' which contains all
   of D except possibly one atom x that is not bound in the context.
   Such a replacement is sound: the only rule inspecting D is An_Assn,
   and binds c (Co ...) G rules out c = x when x is not in dom G.
   ===================================================================== *)

Lemma AnnDefEq_Dsub :
  (forall G (phi:constraint), AnnPropWff G phi -> True) /\
  (forall G D (g:co) (p1 p2:constraint), AnnIso G D g p1 p2 ->
     forall (x:atom) (D':available_props),
       x \notin dom G ->
       (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) ->
       AnnIso G D' g p1 p2) /\
  (forall G D (g:co) (a b:tm), AnnDefEq G D g a b ->
     forall (x:atom) (D':available_props),
       x \notin dom G ->
       (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) ->
       AnnDefEq G D' g a b).
Proof.
  assert (HDE : forall G D (g:co) (a b:tm), AnnDefEq G D g a b ->
     forall (x:atom) (D':available_props),
       x \notin dom G ->
       (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) ->
       AnnDefEq G D' g a b).
  { intros G D g a b d.
    induction d using AnnDefEq_wind with
     (P := fun G a A d => True)
     (P0 := fun G phi d => True)
     (P1 := fun G D g p1 p2 d =>
        forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
        (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnIso G D' g p1 p2)
     (P2 := fun G D g a b d =>
        forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
        (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnDefEq G D' g a b)
     (P3 := fun G d => True) (P4 := fun s d => True).
    all: try exact I.
    all: try (intros x D' Hx Hsub;
      econstructor;
      try assumption;
      [ idtac | idtac | idtac | idtac | idtac | idtac ]).
    all: try (match goal with
      | i : ?c \in ?Ds |- ?c \in ?Dt =>
          destruct (Hsub c i) as [H|H];
          [ exact H
          | exfalso; apply Hx; rewrite <- H; apply binds_dom; eassumption ]
      end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | IH : forall (x0:atom) (D0:available_props), x0 \notin dom ?G0 ->
             (forall c, c \in ?Ds -> c \in D0 \/ c = x0) -> AnnDefEq ?G0 ?D0 ?gg ?aa ?bb
        |- AnnDefEq ?G0 ?D0' ?gg ?aa ?bb =>
          apply (IH x D'); intros c Hc; apply Hsub; exact Hc
      end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | IH : forall (x0:atom) (D0:available_props), x0 \notin dom ?G0 ->
             (forall c, c \in ?Ds -> c \in D0 \/ c = x0) -> AnnIso ?G0 ?D0 ?gg ?p1 ?p2
        |- AnnIso ?G0 ?D0' ?gg ?p1 ?p2 =>
          apply (IH x D'); intros c Hc; apply Hsub; exact Hc
      end).
    all: try assumption.
  }
  repeat split; try exact I.
  - intros. eapply HDE; eassumption.

Lemma dom_insert : forall (Δ Γ G:context) (x:atom),
  x \in dom (Δ ++ G) -> x \in dom (Δ ++ Γ ++ G).
Proof.
  intros Δ. induction Δ as [|[z t] Δ IH]; intros Γ G x H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. apply dom_weak. exact H.
  - simpl in *. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec x z) as [E|E].
    + subst x. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH.
      eapply AtomSetImpl.add_3; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_append_right : forall (A B:context) y s, binds y s A -> binds y s (A ++ B).
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B y s H; simpl.
  - inversion H.
  - destruct H as [E|H].
    + left. exact E.
    + right. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_insert : forall (Δ Γ G:context) y s,
  binds y s (Δ ++ G) -> binds y s (Δ ++ Γ ++ G).
Proof.
  intros Δ Γ G y s H.
  apply binds_app in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - exact (@binds_append_right Δ (Γ ++ G) y s H).
  - exact (@binds_weak_tail Δ (Γ ++ G) y s (@binds_weak_tail Γ G y s H)).
Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed AnnPclosed Commute Weak Weak2 WeakDF3.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   If x is not bound in the context G, then replacing the available-prop
   set D by any D' that contains D except possibly x is sound.
   ===================================================================== *)

Ltac exact_any :=
  match goal with
  | H : ?T |- ?G => exact H
  end.

Ltac dsub_one :=
  try exact I;
  try (intros x D' Hx Hsub;
       econstructor;
       try exact_any;
       try (match goal with
         | i : ?c \in ?Ds |- ?c \in ?Dt =>
             destruct (Hsub c i) as [H|H];
             [ exact H
             | subst c; exfalso; apply Hx; eapply binds_dom; eassumption ]
         end);
       try (match goal with
         | H : ?TT |- ?JJ =>
             let T' := eval hnf in TT in
             lazymatch T' with
             | forall (x0:atom) (D0:available_props), _ =>
                 first [ apply (H x D');
                         [ exact Hx | intros c Hc; exact (Hsub c Hc) ]
                       | fail 1 ]
             end
         end);
       try (match goal with
         | CIH : ?TT |- forall y, y \notin ?LL -> _ =>
             let T' := eval hnf in TT in
             lazymatch T' with
             | forall (y0:atom), y0 \notin ?L0 -> _ =>
                 let Lnew := constr:(L0 \u {{x}}) in
                 unify LL Lnew;
                 intros y Hy;
                 assert (HyL : y \notin L0) by fsetdec;
                 apply (CIH y HyL x D');
                 [ simpl; fsetdec | exact Hsub ]
             end
         end);
       try exact_any).

Lemma AnnDefEq_Dsub : forall G D (g:co) (a b:tm), AnnDefEq G D g a b ->
  forall (x:atom) (D':available_props),
    x \notin dom G ->
    (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) ->
    AnnDefEq G D' g a b.
Proof.
  intros G D g a b d.
  induction d using AnnDefEq_wind with
   (P := fun G a A d => True)
   (P0 := fun G phi d => True)
   (P1 := fun G D g p1 p2 d =>
      forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
      (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnIso G D' g p1 p2)
   (P2 := fun G D g a b d =>
      forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
      (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnDefEq G D' g a b)
   (P3 := fun G d => True) (P4 := fun s d => True).
  all: dsub_one.
Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed AnnPclosed Commute Weak Weak2 WeakDF3 DSub.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Elementary facts about dom, occurrence sets, and substitution identity.
   ===================================================================== *)

Definition occ_sort (s:sort) : atoms :=
  match s with Tm A => occ_tm A | Co p => occ_con p end.

Fixpoint occ_context (G:context) : atoms :=
  match G with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,s) :: G' => occ_sort s \u occ_context G'
  end.

Lemma in_occ_context : forall G y s, binds y s G -> occ_sort s \subseteq occ_context G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros y s Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. simpl. destruct Hb as [E|Hb].
    + inversion E. subst. intros c Hc. fsetdec.
    + intros c Hc. specialize (IH y s Hb c Hc). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma notin_occ_context_sort : forall G y s x,
  x \notin occ_context G -> binds y s G -> x \notin occ_sort s.
Proof.
  intros. intro Hx. apply H. apply (in_occ_context H0). exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma subst_sort_tm_id : forall s x v,
  x \notin occ_sort s -> subst_sort_tm x v s = s.
Proof.
  intros [A|p] x v H; simpl in *;
  [ pose proof (proj1 (proj1 (proj1 (proj1 Subst.subst_id_mut)))) as Ht
  | pose proof (proj1 (proj1 (proj2 (proj1 Subst.subst_id_mut)))) as Hc ];
  [ exact (Ht A x v H) | exact (Hc p x v H) ].
Qed.

Lemma subst_sort_co_id : forall s c g,
  c \notin occ_sort s -> subst_sort_co c g s = s.
Proof.
  intros [A|p] c g H; simpl in *; [|].
Admitted.

(* dom distributes over append *)
Lemma dom_app : forall (A B:context), dom (A ++ B) = dom A \u dom B.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - rewrite IH. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma dom_sing : forall (x:atom) (s:sort), dom [x ~ s] = {{x}}.
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma dom_cons_eq : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G,
  dom ((x ~ s) ++ G) = {{x}} \u dom G.
Proof. intros. rewrite dom_app. rewrite dom_sing. reflexivity. Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Lemma binds_dom : forall (G:context) (xx:atom) (ss:sort), binds xx ss G -> xx \in dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[y s0] G0 IH]; intros xx ss H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. fsetdec.
    + apply IH in H. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma AnnCtx_binds_unique : forall G, AnnCtx G ->
  forall x s1 s2, binds x s1 G -> binds x s2 G -> s1 = s2.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H; intros xx s1 s2 K1 K2.
  - simpl in K1. inversion K1.
  - simpl in K1, K2. destruct K1 as [E1|K1]; destruct K2 as [E2|K2].
    + inversion E1. inversion E2. reflexivity.
    + inversion E1. subst. exfalso. apply H1. exact (@binds_dom G xx s2 K2).
    + inversion E2. subst. exfalso. apply H1. exact (@binds_dom G xx s1 K1).
    + exact (IHAnnCtx xx s1 s2 K1 K2).
  - simpl in K1, K2. destruct K1 as [E1|K1]; destruct K2 as [E2|K2].
    + inversion E1. inversion E2. reflexivity.
    + inversion E1. subst. exfalso. apply H1. exact (@binds_dom G xx s2 K2).
    + inversion E2. subst. exfalso. apply H1. exact (@binds_dom G xx s1 K1).
    + exact (IHAnnCtx xx s1 s2 K1 K2).
Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Coercion substitution is the identity on terms that do not mention the
   substituted coercion variable.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint scid_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm_co c g t = t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_tm t0 -> subst_tm_co c g t0 = t0) with
  | a_Star => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Var_f z => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H;
      cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm b c g H))
  | a_App a rho b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Const T => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm B c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Conv a h => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co h c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_con phi c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm B c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_con phi c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm b c g H))
  | a_CApp a h => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co h c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_DataCon K => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Case a bs => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_brs bs c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_brs (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_co c g bs = bs :=
  match bs as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_brs s0 -> subst_brs_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | br_None => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | br_One K a b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_brs] in H; cbn [subst_brs_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_brs b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_con (p:constraint) {struct p} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_co c g p = p :=
  match p as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_con s0 -> subst_con_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | Eq a b A => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_con] in H; cbn [subst_con_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_co (h:co) {struct h} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_co h -> subst_co_co c g h = h :=
  match h as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_co s0 -> subst_co_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | g_Triv => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | g_Var_b m => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | g_Var_f d => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c) as [E|E];
      [ exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity ])
  | g_Beta a b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Refl a => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm a c g H))
  | g_Refl2 a b hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Sym hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_PiFst hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_CPiFst hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_IsoSnd hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g3 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g3 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g4 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CAppCong hh g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CPiSnd hh g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_con phi1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_con phi2 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Eta a => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm a c g H))
  | g_Left hh hh' => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co hh' c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Right hh hh' => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co hh' c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Coercion substitution is the identity on terms that do not mention the
   substituted coercion variable.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint scid_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_tm t -> subst_tm_co c g t = t :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_tm t0 -> subst_tm_co c g t0 = t0) with
  | a_Star => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Var_f z => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H;
      cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm b c g H))
  | a_App a rho b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Const T => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm B c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Conv a h => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co h c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_CPi phi B => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_con phi c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm B c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_CAbs phi b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_con phi c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_UCAbs b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm b c g H))
  | a_CApp a h => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co h c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | a_Bullet => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_DataCon K => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | a_Case a bs => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_tm] in H; cbn [subst_tm_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_brs bs c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_brs (bs:brs) {struct bs} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_brs bs -> subst_brs_co c g bs = bs :=
  match bs as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_brs s0 -> subst_brs_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | br_None => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | br_One K a b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_brs] in H; cbn [subst_brs_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_brs b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_con (p:constraint) {struct p} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_con p -> subst_con_co c g p = p :=
  match p as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_con s0 -> subst_con_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | Eq a b A => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_con] in H; cbn [subst_con_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  end
with scid_co (h:co) {struct h} :
  forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_co h -> subst_co_co c g h = h :=
  match h as s0 return (forall (c:atom) (g:co), c \notin occ_co s0 -> subst_co_co c g s0 = s0) with
  | g_Triv => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | g_Var_b m => fun c g H => eq_refl
  | g_Var_f d => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec d c) as [E|E];
      [ exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity ])
  | g_Beta a b => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Refl a => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_tm a c g H))
  | g_Refl2 a b hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_tm a c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm b c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Sym hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_PiFst hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_CPiFst hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_IsoSnd hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      exact (scid_co hh c g H))
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g3 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g3 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g4 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CAppCong hh g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_CPiSnd hh g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;
      [ exact (scid_co g1 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_tm A c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co g2 c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 hh => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;

      | exact (scid_con phi2 c g ltac:(fsetdec))
      | exact (scid_co hh c g ltac:(fsetdec)) ])
  | g_Eta a => fun c g H => ltac:(
      cbn [occ_co] in H; cbn [subst_co_co]; f_equal;

Lemma AnnTyping_subst_tm :
  forall (xsub:atom) (vsub:tm) (Asub:tm) (G':context),
    pclosed_tm 0 0 vsub ->
    AnnTyping G' vsub Asub ->
    xsub \notin occ_tm Asub ->
    (forall y s, binds y s G' -> xsub \notin occ_sort s) ->
    forall (Δ0:context), xsub \notin dom Δ0 -> xsub \notin dom G' ->
    AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ0 ++ G') ->
    forall G a A, AnnTyping G a A ->
    G = Δ0 ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
    AnnTyping (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ0 ++ G')
      (subst_tm xsub vsub a) (subst_tm xsub vsub A).
Proof.
  intros xsub vsub Asub G' Hpc Hv HxA HxG Δ0 HxD0 HxGd W0 G0 a0 B0 d0 E0.
  assert (Hmain : forall G a A, AnnTyping G a A ->
      forall (Δ:context), xsub \notin dom Δ ->
      AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') ->
      G = Δ ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
      AnnTyping (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') (subst_tm xsub vsub a) (subst_tm xsub vsub A)).
  { intros G a A d.
  induction d using AnnTyping_wind with
   (P := fun G a A d => forall (Δ:context), xsub \notin dom Δ ->
        AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') ->
        G = Δ ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
        AnnTyping (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G')
          (subst_tm xsub vsub a) (subst_tm xsub vsub A))
   (P0 := fun G phi d => forall (Δ:context), xsub \notin dom Δ ->
        AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') ->
        G = Δ ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
        AnnPropWff (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') (subst_con_tm xsub vsub phi))
   (P1 := fun G D g p1 p2 d => forall (Δ:context), xsub \notin dom Δ ->
        AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') ->
        G = Δ ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
        AnnIso (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') D
          (subst_co_tm xsub vsub g)
          (subst_con_tm xsub vsub p1) (subst_con_tm xsub vsub p2))
   (P2 := fun G D g a b d => forall (Δ:context), xsub \notin dom Δ ->
        AnnCtx (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') ->
        G = Δ ++ (xsub ~ Tm Asub) ++ G' ->
        AnnDefEq (subst_ctx_tm xsub vsub Δ ++ G') D
          (subst_co_tm xsub vsub g)
          (subst_tm xsub vsub a) (subst_tm xsub vsub b))
   (P3 := fun G d => True) (P4 := fun s d => True).
  all: admit.
  }
  exact (Hmain G0 a0 B0 d0 Δ0 HxD0 W0 E0).
Admitted.

Ltac esubst_tac :=
  intros;
  cbn [subst_tm erase_tm subst_con_tm erase_constraint subst_brs_tm erase_brs subst_co_tm];
  try exact I;
  try reflexivity;
  try (match goal with
       | |- context[KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?y ?x] =>
           destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [E|E]; [ subst y; reflexivity | reflexivity ]
       end);
  try f_equal;
  try (match goal with
       | IH : forall x0 v0, _ |- _ =>
           first [ exact (IH _ _) | fail 1 ]
       end);
  try reflexivity.

Lemma erase_subst_mut :
  (forall (a:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm),
     erase_tm (subst_tm x v a) = subst_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_tm a)) /\
  (forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm),
     erase_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p) =
     subst_con_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_constraint p)).
Proof.
  assert (Htm : forall (a:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm),
     erase_tm (subst_tm x v a) = subst_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_tm a)).
  { intros aa xx vv. revert xx vv.
    apply tm_mut with
      (P := fun a => forall x v,
         erase_tm (subst_tm x v a) = subst_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_tm a))
      (P0 := fun bs => True)
      (P1 := fun g => True)
      (P2 := fun p => forall x v,
         erase_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p) =
         subst_con_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_constraint p)).
    all: esubst_tac. }
  assert (Hcon : forall (p:constraint) (x:atom) (v:tm),
     erase_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p) =
     subst_con_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_constraint p)).
  { intros pp xx vv. revert xx vv.
    apply constraint_mut with
      (P := fun a => forall x v,
         erase_tm (subst_tm x v a) = subst_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_tm a))
      (P0 := fun bs => True)
      (P1 := fun g => True)
      (P2 := fun p => forall x v,
         erase_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p) =
         subst_con_tm x (erase_tm v) (erase_constraint p)).
    all: esubst_tac. }
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Substitution does not introduce fresh free atoms.
   ===================================================================== *)

Ltac fv_tac :=
  intros Hu;
  cbn [subst_tm subst_brs_tm subst_con_tm subst_co_tm
       fv_tm_tm_tm fv_tm_tm_brs fv_tm_tm_constraint fv_tm_tm_co] in *;
  try (match goal with
       | |- context[KeySetFacts.eq_dec ?yy ?xx0] =>
           destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec yy xx0) as [E|E];
           [ subst yy; exact Hv | fsetdec ]
       end);
  repeat (first
    [ apply notin_union
    | match goal with
      | IH : z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm ?s -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v ?s)
        |- z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v ?s2) =>
          first [ exact (IH ltac:(fsetdec)) | fail 1 ]
      | IH : z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs ?s -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v ?s)
        |- z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v ?s2) =>
          first [ exact (IH ltac:(fsetdec)) | fail 1 ]
      | IH : z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint ?s -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v ?s)
        |- z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v ?s2) =>
          first [ exact (IH ltac:(fsetdec)) | fail 1 ]
      | IH : z \notin fv_tm_tm_co ?s -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v ?s)
        |- z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v ?s2) =>
          first [ exact (IH ltac:(fsetdec)) | fail 1 ]
      | _ => fsetdec
      end ]).

Lemma fv_subst_notin_mut :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (z:atom),
    z <> x -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm v ->
    ( (forall t, z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t))

    /\ (forall g, z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g)) ).

  intros x v z Hne Hv.
  assert (Htm : forall t, z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t ->
                z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t)).
  { intros tt. induction tt using tm_mut with
      (P := fun t => z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t))
      (P0 := fun bs => z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs bs -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v bs))
      (P1 := fun g => z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g))
      (P2 := fun p => z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint p -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p)).
    all: fv_tac. }
  assert (Hbrs : forall bs, z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs bs ->
                 z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v bs)).
  { intros bb. induction bb using brs_mut with
      (P := fun t => z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t))
      (P0 := fun bs => z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs bs -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v bs))
      (P1 := fun g => z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g))
      (P2 := fun p => z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint p -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p)).
    all: fv_tac. }
  assert (Hco : forall g, z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g ->
                z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g)).
  { intros gg. induction gg using co_mut with
      (P := fun t => z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t))
      (P0 := fun bs => z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs bs -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v bs))
      (P1 := fun g => z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g))
      (P2 := fun p => z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint p -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p)).
    all: fv_tac. }
  assert (Hcon : forall p, z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
                z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p)).
  { intros pp. induction pp using constraint_mut with
      (P := fun t => z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm t -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_tm (subst_tm x v t))
      (P0 := fun bs => z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs bs -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_brs (subst_brs_tm x v bs))
      (P1 := fun g => z \notin fv_tm_tm_co g -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_co (subst_co_tm x v g))
      (P2 := fun p => z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint p -> z \notin fv_tm_tm_constraint (subst_con_tm x v p)).
    all: fv_tac. }
  repeat split; assumption.

(* =====================================================================

  first
    [ fsetdec

             z0 \in occ_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k0 (a_Var_f x0) ?t)

        |- ?z \in occ_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?x) ?t) => exact (IH k x z Hz)
      | IH : forall (k0:nat) (x0:atom) (z0:atom), z0 \in occ_con ?t ->
             z0 \in occ_con (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k0 (a_Var_f x0) ?t)

Lemma erase_pclosed_mut :

      (P1 := fun g => True)
      (P2 := fun p => forall nt nc, pclosed_con nt nc p -> pclosed_con nt nc (erase_constraint p)).

      (P2 := fun p => forall nt nc, pclosed_con nt nc p -> pclosed_con nt nc (erase_constraint p)).
    all: epc. }

            unify G1 G2;
            assert (E : z0 = y) by (symmetry; exact (AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 y z0 Hz));

          assert (Hnil : z \in dom nil) by exact (proj1 IH z Hz);

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Threshold-indexed well-scopedness.

   pclosed_tm nt nc t  : t is well scoped with nt free term binders
                         and nc free coercion binders.
   Binders increment the corresponding threshold.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint pclosed_brs (nt nc:nat) (bs:brs) : Prop :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_brs nt nc b
  end
with pclosed_tm (nt nc:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b m => m < nt
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_UAbs rho b => pclosed_tm (S nt) nc b
  | a_App a rho b => pclosed_tm nt nc a /\ pclosed_tm nt nc b
  | a_Fam _ => True
  | a_Const _ => True
  | a_Pi rho A B => pclosed_tm nt nc A /\ pclosed_tm (S nt) nc B

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Capture-avoiding substitution of a term for a free term variable.
   Binders are de Bruijn, so no shifting is needed: recursion is
   purely structural.  Free atoms are never captured by binders.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint subst_brs_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (bs:brs) {struct bs} : brs :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a b => br_One K (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v b)
  end
with subst_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (t:tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
  | a_Var_f y => if KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x then v else a_Var_f y
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_App a rho b => a_App (subst_tm x v a) rho (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Const T => a_Const T
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (subst_tm x v A) (subst_tm x v B)
  | a_Conv a g => a_Conv (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (subst_con_tm x v phi) (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (subst_tm x v b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (subst_tm x v a) (subst_co_tm x v g)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a bs => a_Case (subst_tm x v a) (subst_brs_tm x v bs)
  end
with subst_con_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (p:constraint) {struct p} : constraint :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => Eq (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_tm x v A)
  end
with subst_co_tm (x:atom) (v:tm) (g:co) {struct g} : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
  | g_Var_f c => g_Var_f c
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (subst_tm x v a)
  | g_Refl2 a b h => g_Refl2 (subst_tm x v a) (subst_tm x v b) (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Sym h => g_Sym (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_PiCong rho g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho g2 => g_AppCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) rho (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_PiFst h => g_PiFst (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_CPiFst h => g_CPiFst (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_IsoSnd h => g_IsoSnd (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g3) (subst_co_tm x v g4)
  | g_CAppCong h g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_CPiSnd h g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_Cast g1 g2 => g_Cast (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (subst_co_tm x v g1) (subst_tm x v A) (subst_co_tm x v g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 h => g_IsoConv (subst_con_tm x v phi1) (subst_con_tm x v phi2) (subst_co_tm x v h)
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (subst_tm x v a)
  | g_Left h h' => g_Left (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v h')
  | g_Right h h' => g_Right (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_co_tm x v h')
  end.

Yes, no shifting; free atoms aren't captured by de Bruijn binders, so substitution is safe syntactically. But lc preservation: `lc_tm t -> lc_tm (subst x v t)` for lc v? Let's see: lc requires closedness wrt de Bruijn. Substitution only replaces free atoms, leaving de Bruijn structure unchanged and replacing a_Var_f by v; if v is lc, then result lc. Proven by induction on t (fixpoint over t), binder case: lc_a_Abs with `forall x, lc (open b x)`. Need for all y, lc (open (subst x v b) y). We have Hbody : forall x, lc(open b x). We want lc(open (subst x v b) y). Rename: choose z fresh-ish? The standard argument: `open (subst x v b) y = subst x (open ...?) ...`. Actually substitution commutes with opening: open (subst x v b) y = subst x v (open b y) provided y ≠ x and y ∉ fv v. Indeed substituting x in b then opening at y; opening at y replaces bound var with y. Since b has no free y? No, b may have free x and free y. If y occurs free in b, then substitution of x shouldn't affect y; open (subst b) y = subst (open b y)? From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Term substitution commutes with term-opening at an ARBITRARY term
   argument (the existing so_tm only handles opening at a free atom).
   The substituted term must be closed for de Bruijn indices.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint g1_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k w t) =
    open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_tm x v t) :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (w:tm), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k w t0) =
    open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm x v w) (subst_tm x v t0)) with
  | a_Star => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m k) as [[E|E]|E]; cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; reflexivity)
  | a_Var_f z => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec z x) as [E|E];
      [ subst z; rewrite (@pid_tm v 0 0 Hv k (Nat.le_0_l k) (subst_tm x v w)); reflexivity
      | reflexivity ])
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm A x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v (S k) w Hv) ])
  | a_UAbs rho b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      exact (g1_tm b x v (S k) w Hv))
  | a_App a rho b => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm a x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm b x v k w Hv) ])
  | a_Fam F => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Const T => fun x v k w Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Pi rho A B => fun x v k w Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;
      [ exact (g1_tm A x v k w Hv) | exact (g1_tm B x v (S k) w Hv) ])

For the Value part, maybe we can avoid proving general Value-subst by structural decomposition of Value (a_UAbs rho v0):
- If rho = Rel: Value_UAbsRel gives lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel v0). Need Value (a_UAbs Rel (subst v0)) — Value_UAbsRel needs lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel (subst v0)), which follows from lc_tm of the original under substitution (one application of lc_preservation to the whole a_UAbs term; note lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel v0) and the substitution result is exactly subst (a_UAbs...)). So we need `lc_tm t -> lc_tm (subst t)` for general t! Not just bodies.
- If rho = Irrel: Value_UAbsIrrel L v0 with forall y∉L, Value(open v0 y). Need Value (a_UAbs Irrel (subst v0)): use Value_UAbsIrrel with L' = L ∪ {x} ∪ fv(v) maybe, and for y ∉ L', y ≠ x, open (subst v0) y = subst x v (open v0 y) via g1. Then need Value-preservation at open v0 y, which has a Value derivation available (H y Hy). But general Value-preservation proof by induction on Value derivation would need lc preservation (for the Rel/abs cases) and again in the Irrel case use IH on premise `forall y, ...`. Wait can we do induction on the *Value derivation* while the substitution parameters x,v vary? Yes: state ∀ t, Value t -> (∀ x v, pclosed v -> Value (subst x v t)). Induct on Value t. In the Value_UAbsIrrel case the IH for premise is `forall y, y∉L -> forall x v, pclosed v -> Value (subst x v (open a y))` — exactly what we need after rewriting. No structural size issue! Because Value is inductive with binder premises as universally quantified functions. Great.

Similarly lc preservation can be done by induction on the lc derivation, not structural on term. In the lc_a_Abs case, the premise HB : forall y, lc(open b y) yields IH: forall y, lc(subst (open b y)) (when the lemma is stated with the substitution parameters universally quantified inside the motive and induction is on derivation). Then to prove forall y, lc(open (subst b) y): for y ≠ x use g1 rewrite; for y = x we need lc(open (subst b) x) and the IH gives for y' ≠ x... still the y=x problem, but now we can use the IH at a different y' and relate by renaming. Let's think about the equality open (subst x v b) x. Could we simplify it? `open_tm_wrt_tm (subst x v b) x` — opening at index 0 with var x. Composition law: subst then open at x. There is `so_tm` etc: if x ∉ b then subst x v (open b x) = open b v. But here x may be in b.

Alternative: Avoid needing lc(open (subst b) x) by proving lc_a_Abs's premise for all y via a "fresh renaming" argument, proving a general lemma:

Lemma lc_open_rename : lc_tm (open b z) -> z ∉ fv b -> forall y, lc_tm (open b y).

Hmm: if lc(open b z) and z ∉ fv b, then for any y, open b y = ren (z→y) (open b z)?? Check: open b z has z inserted at index-0 positions. ren f with f z = y, f a = a otherwise. Then index-0 positions become y. Original free atoms of b: z doesn't occur free, others unchanged. So yes, ren f (open b z) = open b y. And renaming preserves lc? For this specific f (a "substitution of one atom by another", non-injective) — does lc renaming preservation hold? lc's binder premises open bodies at all atoms; renaming a locally closed term is locally closed (since renaming preserves de Bruijn structure). We can prove lc_ren for arbitrary f by induction on the lc derivation, with the binder premise IH forall y, lc(ren f (open b y)). Need forall y, lc(open (ren f b) y). Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   Term substitution commutes with coercion-opening at an ARBITRARY
   coercion argument.  (soc_tm only handles opening at a free atom.)
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint g2_tm (t:tm) {struct t} :
  forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h t) =
    open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_tm x v t) :=
  match t as t0 return (forall (x:atom) (v:tm) (k:nat) (h:co), pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    subst_tm x v (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h t0) =
    open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (subst_co_tm x v h) (subst_tm x v t0)) with
  | a_Star => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_b m => fun x v k h Hv => eq_refl
  | a_Var_f z => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm];
      destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec z x) as [E|E];
      [ subst z; rewrite (@pic_tm v 0 0 Hv k (Nat.le_0_l k) (subst_co_tm x v h)); reflexivity
      | reflexivity ])
  | a_Abs rho A b => fun x v k h Hv => ltac:(
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec subst_tm]; f_equal;

(** syntax *)
Definition tmvar := var. (*r variables *)
Definition covar := var. (*r coercion variables *)
Definition datacon := atom.
Definition const := atom.
Definition tyfam := atom.
Inductive relflag : Set :=  (*r relevance flag *)
 | Rel : relflag
 | Irrel : relflag.

Inductive tm : Set :=  (*r types and kinds *)
 | a_Star : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Abs (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_UAbs (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_Fam (F:tyfam)
 | a_Const (T:const)

 | a_CAbs (phi:constraint) (b:tm)
 | a_UCAbs (b:tm)
 | a_CApp (a:tm) (g:co)
 | a_Bullet : tm
 | a_DataCon (K:datacon)
 | a_Case (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
with brs : Set :=  (*r case branches *)
 | br_None : brs
 | br_One (K:datacon) (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
with co : Set :=  (*r explicit coercions *)
 | g_Triv : co
 | g_Var_b (_:nat)
 | g_Var_f (c:covar)
 | g_Beta (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | g_Refl (a:tm)
 | g_Refl2 (a:tm) (b:tm) (g:co)
 | g_Sym (g:co)
 | g_Trans (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_PiCong (rho:relflag) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AbsCong (rho:relflag) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AppCong (g1:co) (rho:relflag) (g2:co)
 | g_PiFst (g:co)
 | g_CPiFst (g:co)
 | g_IsoSnd (g:co)
 | g_PiSnd (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiCong (g1:co) (g3:co)
 | g_CAbsCong (g1:co) (g3:co) (g4:co)
 | g_CAppCong (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiSnd (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_Cast (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_EqCong (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co)
 | g_IsoConv (phi1:constraint) (phi2:constraint) (g:co)
 | g_Eta (a:tm)
 | g_Left (g:co) (g':co)
 | g_Right (g:co) (g':co)
with constraint : Set :=  (*r props *)
 | Eq (a:tm) (b:tm) (A:tm).

Inductive sort : Set :=  (*r binding classifier *)
 | Tm (A:tm)
 | Co (phi:constraint).

Inductive sig_sort : Set :=  (*r signature classifier *)
 | Cs (A:tm)
 | Ax (a:tm) (A:tm).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

(* EXPERIMENTAL *)
(** auxiliary functions on the new list types *)
(** library functions *)
(** subrules *)
(** arities *)
(** opening up abstractions *)

  match brs_6 with
  | br_None => br_None

  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Abs rho A b) => a_Abs rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_UAbs rho b) => a_UAbs rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_App a rho b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Fam F) => a_Fam F
  | (a_Const T) => a_Const T
  | (a_Pi rho A B) => a_Pi rho (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)

  | (a_CAbs phi b) => a_CAbs (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k a5 phi) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_UCAbs b) => a_UCAbs (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_CApp a g) => a_CApp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k a5 g)
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | (a_DataCon K) => a_DataCon K
  | (a_Case a brs5) => a_Case (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k a5 brs5)
end
with open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (phi5:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A) => Eq (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
end
with open_co_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (g_5:co) {struct g_5}: co :=
  match g_5 with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | (g_Var_b nat) => g_Var_b nat
  | (g_Var_f c) => g_Var_f c

Require Import Language.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* =====================================================================
   A structural size measure, used for well-founded induction relating
   pclosed_tm 0 0 and lc_tm.  Opening at a free atom preserves the size.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint size_tm (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_Star => 1
  | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Var_f _ => 1
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (size_tm A + size_tm b)
  | a_UAbs _ b => S (size_tm b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Fam _ => 1
  | a_Const _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_Conv a g => S (size_tm a + size_co g)
  | a_CPi p B => S (size_con p + size_tm B)
  | a_CAbs p b => S (size_con p + size_tm b)
  | a_UCAbs b => S (size_tm b)
  | a_CApp a g => S (size_tm a + size_co g)
  | a_Bullet => 1
  | a_DataCon _ => 1
  | a_Case a bs => S (size_tm a + size_brs bs)
  end
with size_brs (bs:brs) : nat :=
  match bs with
  | br_None => 1
  | br_One _ a b => S (size_tm a + size_brs b)
  end
with size_con (p:constraint) : nat :=
  match p with
  | Eq a b A => S (size_tm a + size_tm b + size_tm A)
  end
with size_co (g:co) : nat :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => 1

Lemma subst_erase_FixDef : forall (x:atom) (w:tm),
  subst_tm x w (erase_tm FixDef) = erase_tm FixDef.
Proof.
  intros. cbn [erase_tm FixDef subst_tm]. reflexivity.

Lemma binds_toplevel_fst : forall (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
  binds F (Ax a A) toplevel -> a = erase_tm FixDef.
Proof.
  intros F a A Hb.
  unfold toplevel in Hb. unfold an_toplevel in Hb. unfold erase_sig in Hb. simpl in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [E|Hnil].
  - inversion E. reflexivity.
  - inversion Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma Beta_subst :
  forall (b1 b2:tm) (x:atom) (v:tm),
    Beta b1 b2 -> pclosed_tm 0 0 v ->
    Beta (subst_tm x v b1) (subst_tm x v b2).

  induction H; intros x w Hpc.
  - (* Beta_AppAbs *)

    assert (E : subst_tm x w (open_tm_wrt_tm v b) =

Lemma open_inj_tm : forall k (x:atom) (t1 t2:tm), x \notin occ_tm t1 -> x \notin occ_tm t2 ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t1 = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t2 -> t1 = t2.
Proof.
  intros k x t1 t2 H1 H2 Heq.
  rewrite <- (@co_open_tm t1 k x H1). rewrite <- (@co_open_tm t2 k x H2). rewrite Heq. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma AnnTyping_bullet : forall G A, AnnTyping G a_Bullet A -> False.
Proof. intros G A d. inversion d. Qed.
Lemma an_toplevel_binds : forall F a A, binds F (Ax a A) an_toplevel -> A = FixTy.

Require Import Language Dev0 CompTest Occ Syn FixTP FixCO Ren RenOpen Erase Ctx Subst Pclosed
        AnnPclosed Commute Weak Weak2 WeakDF3 DSub Helper HelperCo CoId Gen1 Gen2 Gen3 Gen4
        OpenSubst EraseSubst EraseCoSubst FvSubst FvNil ErasePclosed BetaSubst SubstAnnT
        SubstAnnC Coh AnnCtxJ Reg AnnLift EraseMutual AnnCtxAll.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition StarPiCPi (G:context) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  (forall (phi:constraint) (B:tm), a = a_CPi phi B -> AnnTyping G a a_Star) /\
  (forall (rho:relflag) (A B:tm), a = a_Pi rho A B -> AnnTyping G a a_Star).
Definition P1M (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (p1 p2:constraint) (_:AnnIso G D g p1 p2) : Prop :=
  Iso (erase_context G) D (erase_constraint p1) (erase_constraint p2) /\
  AnnPropWff G p1 /\ AnnPropWff G p2.
Definition P2M (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (a b:tm) (_:AnnDefEq G D g a b) : Prop :=
  (forall A, AnnTyping G a A -> DefEq (erase_context G) D (erase_tm a) (erase_tm b) (erase_tm A)) /\
  TC G a b /\ StarPiCPi G a.
Definition P3M (G:context) (_:AnnCtx G) : Prop :=
  Ctx (erase_context G) /\ forall c t, binds c t G -> binds c (erase_sort t) (erase_context G).

Lemma P3M_ctx : forall G d, @P3M G d -> Ctx (erase_context G).
Proof. intros G d H; exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma P3M_binds : forall G d, @P3M G d -> forall c t, binds c t G -> binds c (erase_sort t) (erase_context G).
Proof. intros G d H; exact (proj2 H). Qed.
Lemma P1M_iso : forall G D g p1 p2 d, @P1M G D g p1 p2 d -> Iso (erase_context G) D (erase_constraint p1) (erase_constraint p2).
Proof. intros; exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma P1M_wff1 : forall G D g p1 p2 d, @P1M G D g p1 p2 d -> AnnPropWff G p1.
Proof. intros; exact (proj1 (proj2 H)). Qed.
Lemma P1M_wff2 : forall G D g p1 p2 d, @P1M G D g p1 p2 d -> AnnPropWff G p2.
Proof. intros; exact (proj2 (proj2 H)). Qed.
Lemma P2M_law : forall G D g a b d, @P2M G D g a b d -> forall A, AnnTyping G a A -> DefEq (erase_context G) D (erase_tm a) (erase_tm b) (erase_tm A).
Proof. intros; exact (proj1 H A H0). Qed.
Lemma P2M_tc : forall G D g a b d, @P2M G D g a b d -> TC G a b.
Proof. intros; exact (proj1 (proj2 H)). Qed.
Lemma P2M_star : forall G D g a b d, @P2M G D g a b d -> StarPiCPi G a.
Proof. intros; exact (proj2 (proj2 H)). Qed.
Hint Resolve P3M_ctx P3M_binds P1M_iso P1M_wff1 P1M_wff2 P2M_law P2M_tc P2M_star : core.
Hint Constructors Typing PropWff Iso DefEq Ctx : core.
Ltac em := (try unfold P1M in |- *); (try unfold P2M in |- *); (try unfold P3M in |- *); (try unfold TC in |- *); (try unfold StarPiCPi in |- *); cbn [erase_tm erase_constraint erase_context erase_sort]; eauto 5.

Lemma erase_typing_try : forall (G:context) (a A:tm), AnnTyping G a A ->
  Typing (erase_context G) (erase_tm a) (erase_tm A).
Proof.
  intros G a A d.
  induction d using AnnTyping_wind with
   (P := fun G a A d => Typing (erase_context G) (erase_tm a) (erase_tm A))
   (P0 := fun G phi d => PropWff (erase_context G) (erase_constraint phi))
   (P1 := P1M) (P2 := P2M) (P3 := P3M) (P4 := fun s d => True).
  all: try em.
  all: match goal with |- ?G => idtac "REMAIN:" G end.
  all: admit.
Admitted.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia List.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Lemma binds_weak_tail : forall (A B:context) y s, binds y s B -> binds y s (A ++ B).
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B y s H; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - right. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma dom_weak : forall (Γ G:context) (x:atom), x \in dom G -> x \in dom (Γ ++ G).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [|[z t] Γ IH]; intros G x H.
  - exact H.
  - simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma AnnTyping_pi_inv : forall G rho A B, AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A B) a_Star -> AnnTyping G A a_Star.
Proof.
  intros G rho A B H. inversion H; subst; try assumption; try discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma AnnTyping_cpi_inv : forall G phi B, AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi B) a_Star -> AnnPropWff G phi.
Proof.
  intros G phi B H. inversion H; subst; try assumption; try discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma AnnTyping_cabs_inv : forall G phi a B, AnnTyping G (a_CAbs phi a) (a_CPi phi B) -> AnnPropWff G phi.
Proof.
  intros G phi a B H. inversion H; subst; try assumption; try discriminate.
Qed.

   D-monotonicity for the property-relevant judgments.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint AnnDefEq_mono (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (a b:tm)
    (d:AnnDefEq G D g a b) {struct d} :
  forall D', (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D') -> AnnDefEq G D' g a b :=
  match d as d0 in AnnDefEq G0 D0 g0 a0 b0 return
    (forall D', (forall c, c \in D0 -> c \in D') -> AnnDefEq G0 D' g0 a0 b0) with
  | An_Assn G0 D0 c a0 b0 A0 HC Hb Hin => fun D' Hsub =>
      An_Assn G0 D' c a0 b0 A0 HC Hb (Hsub c Hin)
  | An_Refl G0 D0 a0 A0 Ht => fun D' Hsub => An_Refl G0 D' a0 A0 Ht
  | An_EraseEq G0 D0 a0 b0 g0 A0 B0 Hta Htb He Hd => fun D' Hsub =>
      An_EraseEq G0 D' a0 b0 g0 A0 B0 Hta Htb He
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 (dom G0) g0 A0 B0 Hd (dom G0) (fun c H => H))
  | An_Sym G0 D0 g0 a0 b0 B0 A0 g1 Htb Hta Hde Hd => fun D' Hsub =>
      An_Sym G0 D' g0 a0 b0 B0 A0 g1 Htb Hta
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 (dom G0) g1 B0 A0 Hde (dom G0) (fun c H => H))
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 D0 g0 b0 a0 Hd D' Hsub)
  | An_Trans G0 D0 g1 g2 a0 b0 a1 A0 A1 g3 Hd1 Hd2 Hta Hta1 Hde => fun D' Hsub =>
      An_Trans G0 D' g1 g2 a0 b0 a1 A0 A1 g3
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 D0 g1 a0 a1 Hd1 D' Hsub)
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 D0 g2 a1 b0 Hd2 D' Hsub) Hta Hta1
        (@AnnDefEq_mono G0 (dom G0) g3 A0 A1 Hde (dom G0) (fun c H => H))
  | An_Beta G0 D0 a1 a2 B0 B1 Hta Htb He Hbeta => fun D' Hsub =>
      An_Beta G0 D' a1 a2 B0 B1 Hta Htb He Hbeta

Set Implicit Arguments.

(* Erased weakening.  This is the erasure-side analogue of Weak2.v.
   The functions [Typing_weak], [PropWff_weak], [Iso_weak] and
   [DefEq_weak] are defined by mutual recursion on the erased
   derivations.  The available-props parameter is weakened along a
   supplied inclusion, which is what is needed for the occurrences of
   [dom G] in E_Conv/E_CApp. *)

Fixpoint Typing_weak (G:context) (a A:tm) (d:Typing G a A) {struct d} :
  forall Δ G' Γ, G = Δ ++ G' -> Ctx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') ->
  Typing (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') a A
with PropWff_weak (G:context) (phi:constraint) (d:PropWff G phi) {struct d} :
  forall Δ G' Γ, G = Δ ++ G' -> Ctx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') ->
  PropWff (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') phi

    (d:Iso G D g p1 p2) {struct d} :
  forall Δ G' Γ, G = Δ ++ G' -> (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D') ->
  Ctx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> Iso (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') D' g p1 p2
with DefEq_weak (G:context) (D D':available_props) (g:co) (a b A:tm)
    (d:DefEq G D g a b A) {struct d} :
  forall Δ G' Γ, G = Δ ++ G' -> (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D') ->
  Ctx (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') -> DefEq (Δ ++ Γ ++ G') D' g a b A.

      |G0 x A Hb
      |L G0 rho A B H HA
      |L G0 rho a A B H HA HR
      |G0 b a B A H1 H2
      |G0 b B a A H1 H2
      |G0 a B A H1 Hde H2
      |L G0 phi B H HP
      |L G0 a phi B H HP
      |G0 a1 B1 a b A H1 Hde
      |G0 F A a HC Hb Hnil].
    + eapply E_Star; exact W.
    + eapply E_Var; eapply binds_insert; eassumption.
    + eapply E_Pi.
      * intros x Hx.
        assert (HxL : x \notin L) by fsetdec.
        assert (Hxd : x \notin dom (Δ ++ Γ ++ G')) by fsetdec.
        assert (HA' := Typing_weak H (G:=G0) (a:=A) (A:=a_Star) Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
        assert (Wx : Ctx (((x ~ Tm A) ++ Δ) ++ Γ ++ G'))
          by (eapply E_ConsTm; [ exact W | exact HA' | exact Hxd ]).
        exact (Typing_weak (H x HxL) ((x ~ Tm A) ++ Δ) G' Γ eq_refl Wx).
      * exact (Typing_weak H Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
    + eapply E_Abs.
      * intros x Hx.
        assert (HxL : x \notin L) by fsetdec.
        assert (Hxd : x \notin dom (Δ ++ Γ ++ G')) by fsetdec.
        assert (HA' := Typing_weak H0 (G:=G0) (a:=A) (A:=a_Star) Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
        assert (Wx : Ctx (((x ~ Tm A) ++ Δ) ++ Γ ++ G'))
          by (eapply E_ConsTm; [ exact W | exact HA' | exact Hxd ]).
        exact (Typing_weak (H x HxL) ((x ~ Tm A) ++ Δ) G' Γ eq_refl Wx).
      * exact (Typing_weak H0 Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
      * intros x Hx; apply HR; fsetdec.
    + eapply E_App; [ exact (Typing_weak H1 Δ G' Γ eq_refl W)

    + eapply E_IApp; [ exact (Typing_weak H1 Δ G' Γ eq_refl W)

    + eapply E_Conv.
      * exact (Typing_weak H1 Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).

        intros c Hc. eapply (@dom_insert Δ Γ G' c); exact Hc.

      * exact (Typing_weak H2 Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
    + eapply E_CPi.
      * intros c Hc.
        assert (HcL : c \notin L) by fsetdec.
        assert (Hcd : c \notin dom (Δ ++ Γ ++ G')) by fsetdec.
        assert (HP' := PropWff_weak HP Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
        assert (Wc : Ctx (((c ~ Co phi) ++ Δ) ++ Γ ++ G'))
          by (eapply E_ConsCo; [ exact W | exact HP' | exact Hcd ]).
        exact (Typing_weak (H c HcL) ((c ~ Co phi) ++ Δ) G' Γ eq_refl Wc).
      * exact (PropWff_weak HP Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).

      * exact (PropWff_weak HP Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
    + eapply E_CApp.

      |G0 D0 a b A H
      |G0 D0 a b A a1 H1 H2
      |G0 D0 a1 a2 B H1 H2 HB
      |L G0 D0 rho A1 B1 A2 B2 Hde Hbody HA1 Hpi1 Hpi2
      |L G0 D0 rho b1 b2 A1 B Hbody HA1 HR1 HR2
      |G0 D0 a1 a2 b1 b2 B A H1 H2
      |G0 D0 a1 b1 B a A H1 H2
      |G0 D0 A1 A2 rho B1 B2 H
      |G0 D0 B1 a1 B2 a2 rho A1 A2 H1 H2
      |L G0 D0 phi1 A phi2 B Hiso Hbody HP Hcp1 Hcp2
      |L G0 D0 a b phi1 B Hbody HP

      |G0 D0 a' b' A' a b A H1 H2
      |G0 D0 a b B A H1 H2
      |G0 D0 A A' a b a' b' H].

      * exact W.
      * eapply binds_insert; eassumption.
      * exact (Hsub c Hin).
    + eapply E_Refl. exact (Typing_weak H Δ G' Γ eq_refl W).
    + eapply E_Sym. exact (DefEq_weak H Δ G' Γ Hsub W).
    + eapply E_Trans.

Lemma AnnDefEq_Dsub : forall G D (g:co) (a b:tm), AnnDefEq G D g a b ->
  forall (x:atom) (D':available_props),
    x \notin dom G ->
    (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) ->
    AnnDefEq G D' g a b.
Proof.
  intros G D g a b d.
  induction d using AnnDefEq_wind with
   (P := fun G a A d => True)
   (P0 := fun G phi d => True)
   (P1 := fun G D g p1 p2 d =>
      forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
      (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnIso G D' g p1 p2)
   (P2 := fun G D g a b d =>
      forall (x:atom) (D':available_props), x \notin dom G ->
      (forall c, c \in D -> c \in D' \/ c = x) -> AnnDefEq G D' g a b)
   (P3 := fun G d => True) (P4 := fun s d => True).
  all: dsub_one.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_tm : forall G x v y s,
  binds y s (subst_ctx_tm x v G) ->
  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_tm x v s'.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
    + destruct (IH x v y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co : forall G c g y s,
  binds y s (subst_ctx_co c g G) ->
  exists s', binds y s' G /\ s = subst_sort_co c g s'.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros c g y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. exists t. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
    + destruct (IH c g y s H) as [s' [Hb He]]. exists s'. split; [right; exact Hb|exact He].
Qed.

  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_tm x v s) (subst_ctx_tm x v G).
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|[z t] G IH]; intros x v y s H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [E|H].
    + inversion E. subst. left; reflexivity.
    + right. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_ctx_co_fwd : forall G c g y s,
  binds y s G -> binds y (subst_sort_co c g s) (subst_ctx_co c g G).

    + right. apply IH. exact H.

Lemma binds_app : forall (A B:context) y s,
  binds y s (A ++ B) -> binds y s A \/ binds y s B.

  intros A. induction A as [|[z t] A IH]; intros B y s H.
